BDAG.en: to be engaged in an exchange, exchange; metaph. discuss
BDAG.pt: estar engajado em uma troca, trocar; metaforicamente, discutir

DEFINITION: to oppose, set oneself in opposition.
ORIGIN: From anti and diatithemai; to set oneself opposite, i.e. Be disputatious.

DEFINITION: an opponent (at law), an adversary.
ORIGIN: From anti and dike; an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy).

BDAG.en: one who brings a charge in a lawsuit, accuser, plaintiff; one who is continuously antagonistic to another, enemy, opponent in gener.
BDAG.pt: aquele que move uma acusação em um processo, acusador, demandante; aquele que é continuamente antagônico a outro, inimigo, oponente em geral

DEFINITION: a proposition, tenet, opinion advanced by one party against another; opposition.
ORIGIN: From a compound of anti and tithemi; opposition, i.e. A conflict (of theories).

BDAG.en: a statement that involves contradiction or inconsistency, contradiction
BDAG.pt: uma declaração que envolve contradição ou inconsistência, contradição

DEFINITION: to set down against, to replace, oppose.
ORIGIN: From anti and kathistemi; to set down (troops) against, i.e. Withstand.

BDAG.en: oppose, resist
BDAG.pt: opor-se, resistir

DEFINITION: to invite in return.
ORIGIN: From anti and kaleo; to invite in return.

BDAG.en: invite in return
BDAG.pt: convidar em troca

DEFINITION: to resist, oppose, withstand, lie opposite to.
ORIGIN: From anti and keimai; to lie opposite, i.e. Be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to.

BDAG.en: be opposed to someone, be in opposition to; opponent, enemy
BDAG.pt: ser contrário a alguém, estar em oposição a; opositor, inimigo

DEFINITION: right opposite, off (nautical sense), over against.
ORIGIN: Prolonged from anti; opposite.

DEFINITION: to take hold of, help, share in, partake of, enjoy.
ORIGIN: From anti and the middle voice of lambano; to take hold of in turn, i.e. Succor; also to participate.

DEFINITION: to speak or say in opposition, contradict (oppose, resist).
ORIGIN: From anti and lego; to dispute, refuse.
USAGE: answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay(-er), speak against.

BDAG.en: speak against, contradict; oppose, refuse; deny (with μή + infinitive); reject a writing as spurious
BDAG.pt: falar contra, contradizer; opor-se, recusar; negar (com μή + infinitivo); rejeitar um escrito como espúrio

DEFINITION: help, ministration; one who aids.
ORIGIN: From antilambanomai; relief.

DEFINITION: contradiction, contention, rebellion.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of antilego; dispute, disobedience.

BDAG.en: contradiction, dispute; hostility, rebellion
BDAG.pt: contradição, disputa; hostilidade, rebelião

DEFINITION: to abuse in return, give abuse for abuse.
ORIGIN: From anti and loidoreo; to rail in reply.

BDAG.en: revile in return
BDAG.pt: insultar em troca

DEFINITION: a ransom.
ORIGIN: From anti and lutron; a redemption-price.

BDAG.en: ransom
BDAG.pt: resgate

DEFINITION: to measure in return, give equivalent measure.
ORIGIN: From anti and metreo; to mete in return.

BDAG.en: measure in return to someone
BDAG.pt: medir em troca para alguém

DEFINITION: a reward, recompense, retribution.
ORIGIN: From a compound of anti and misthos; requital, correspondence.

BDAG.en: recompense, exchange, either in the positive sense of reward or the negative sense penalty, depending on the context
BDAG.pt: recompensa, troca, seja no sentido positivo de recompensa ou no sentido negativo de penalidade, dependendo do contexto

DEFINITION: Antioch, (a) Antioch on the river Orontes, capital of the Province Syria, (b) Pisidian Antioch, not in Pisidia, but near Pisidia, in the Roman Province Galatia.
ORIGIN: From Antiochus (a Syrian king); Antiochia, a place in Syria.

BDAG.en: Antioch. 1. A. on the Orontes, the largest city in Syria... 2. Pisidian A....
BDAG.pt: Antioquia. 1. A. no Orontes, a maior cidade da Síria... 2. Antioquia Pisídia...

DEFINITION: an Antiochian, an inhabitant of Antioch.
ORIGIN: From Antiocheia; an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia.

BDAG.en: an Antiochene (Syrian A.), of the proselyte Nicolaus
BDAG.pt: um Antioqueno (Sírio de A.), referente ao prosélito Nicolau

DEFINITION: to pass opposite, on the opposite side of the road.
ORIGIN: From anti and parerchomai; to go along opposite.
USAGE: pass by on the other side.

BDAG.en: pass by on the opposite side
BDAG.pt: passar pelo lado oposto

DEFINITION: Antipas, a Christian martyr of Pergamum.
ORIGIN: Contracted for a compound of anti and a derivative of pater; Antipas, a Christian.

BDAG.en: Antipas, martyr in Pergamum
BDAG.pt: Antipas, mártir em Pérgamo

DEFINITION: Antipatris, a town, where was a Roman colony, on the road between Caesarea and Jerusalem.
ORIGIN: From the same as Antipas; Antipatris, a place in Palestine.

BDAG.en: Antipatris city in Judea founded by Herod the Great and named after his father
BDAG.pt: Antipatris, cidade na Judeia fundada por Herodes, o Grande, e nomeada em homenagem ao seu pai

DEFINITION: on the opposite side or shore.
ORIGIN: From anti and peran; on the opposite side.

DEFINITION: to resist, oppose, fall against or upon.
ORIGIN: From anti and pipto (including its alternate); to oppose.

BDAG.en: resist, oppose (with dative)
BDAG.pt: resistir, opor-se (com dativo)

DEFINITION: to campaign against, war against.
ORIGIN: From anti and strateuomai; (figuratively) to attack, i.e. (by implication) destroy.

BDAG.en: be at war with τινί, only fig.
BDAG.pt: estar em guerra contra alguém (τινί), apenas em sentido figurado

DEFINITION: to range in battle against, to set oneself against.
ORIGIN: From anti and the middle voice of tasso; to range oneself against, i.e. Oppose.

DEFINITION: typical of, representing by type (or pattern), corresponding to, an image.
ORIGIN: Neuter of a compound of anti and tupos; corresponding ("antitype"), i.e. A representative, counterpart.

BDAG.en: of someth. that corresponds to another; esp. used metaph. 1 pert. to that which corresponds to someth. else, adj. corresponding to someth. that has gone before... 2 subst. copy, antitype, representation
BDAG.pt: de algo que corresponde a outro; especialmente usado metaforicamente. 1. Pertencente àquilo que corresponde a algo anterior, adjetivo correspondente... 2. Substantivo: cópia, antítipo, representação

DEFINITION: antichrist, either one who puts himself in the place of, or the enemy (opponent) of the Messiah.
ORIGIN: From anti and Christos; an opponent of the Messiah.

BDAG.en: antichrist, adversary of the Messiah, to appear in the last days
BDAG.pt: anticristo, adversário do Messias, que aparecerá nos últimos dias

DEFINITION: to draw (generally water from a deep well in the ground); perhaps: to draw out.
ORIGIN: From antlos (the hold of a ship); to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. Dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.).

BDAG.en: 1 to draw a liquid from a source, draw, water understood... 2 fig. endure
BDAG.pt: 1 tirar um líquido de uma fonte, tirar (água subentendida)... 2 figurativamente, suportar

DEFINITION: what is drawn; a vessel or bucket to draw with.
ORIGIN: From antleo; a baling-vessel.

BDAG.en: a bucket for drawing water
BDAG.pt: um balde para tirar água

DEFINITION: to face (lit: to present eye to), resist, withstand; as nautical term: to bear up against the wind.
ORIGIN: From a compound of anti and ophthalmos; to face.

BDAG.en: the term suggests an eye that is focused directly on someth. look directly at... Metaph. of a ship... face the wind
BDAG.pt: o termo sugere um olho focado diretamente em algo, olhar diretamente para... Metaforicamente, de um navio... enfrentar o vento

DEFINITION: without water, dry; subst: dry places, desert.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and hudor; waterless, i.e. Dry.

BDAG.en: waterless, dry; (fig.) springs without water; clouds that yield no rain
BDAG.pt: sem água, seco; (fig.) fontes sem água; nuvens que não dão chuva

DEFINITION: unfeigned, without hypocrisy, sincere.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of hupokrinomai; undissembled, i.e. Sincere.

BDAG.en: pert. to being without pretense, genuine, sincere, lit. ‘without play-acting’ (love, faith, wisdom)
BDAG.pt: relativo a ser sem pretensão, genuíno, sincero, literalmente ‘sem simulação’ (amor, fé, sabedoria)

DEFINITION: not subject to rule, unruly.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of hupotasso; unsubdued, i.e. Insubordinate (in fact or temper).
USAGE: disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.

BDAG.en: 1 not made subject, independent... 2 pert. to refusing submission to authority, undisciplined, disobedient, rebellious
BDAG.pt: 1 não subjugado, independente... 2 referente a recusar submissão à autoridade, indisciplinado, desobediente, rebelde

DEFINITION: up, above, up to the top, up to the brim, things above, heaven, the heavenly region.
ORIGIN: Adverb from anti; upward or on the top.

BDAG.en: 1 at a position above another position, above... As adj. the Jerus. above, the heavenly (or future) Jerus.... As subst. what is above=heaven... 2 extension toward a goal which is up, upward(s), up
BDAG.pt: 1 em uma posição acima de outra posição, acima... Como adjetivo: a Jerusalém de cima, a Jerusalém celestial (ou futura)... Como substantivo: aquilo que está acima = céu... 2 extensão em direção a um objetivo que é para cima, para cima

DEFINITION: an upper room.
ORIGIN: From ano and ge; above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story.

DEFINITION: (a) from above, from heaven, (b) from the beginning, from their origin (source), from of old, (c) again, anew.
ORIGIN: From ano; from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew.
USAGE: from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.

BDAG.en: from above (from heaven); from the beginning; for a long time; again, anew (be born again)
BDAG.pt: de cima (do céu); desde o princípio; por muito tempo; de novo, novamente (nascer de novo)

DEFINITION: upper, higher-lying, inland.
ORIGIN: From anoteros; superior, i.e. (locally) more remote.

BDAG.en: upper (i.e. inland) country, the interior
BDAG.pt: a região superior (isto é, interior), o interior

DEFINITION: higher, to a more honorable place (at the dinner table); previously, in an earlier passage (or a book), above.
ORIGIN: Comparative degree of ano; upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book.

DEFINITION: useless, unprofitable.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and the base of ophelimos; useless or (neuter) inutility.

BDAG.en: not being of any advantage, useless; damaging, harmful
BDAG.pt: que não traz vantagem, inútil; prejudicial, nocivo

DEFINITION: an axe.
ORIGIN: Probably from agnumi (to break; compare rhegnumi); an axe.

BDAG.en: ax used for cutting wood
BDAG.pt: machado usado para cortar madeira

DEFINITION: worthy, worthy of, deserving, comparable, suitable.
ORIGIN: Probably from ago; deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise).

BDAG.en: having a high degree of comparable worth or value, corresponding, comparable, worthy (of price or relation); correspondingly fitting or appropriate, worthy, fit, deserving (of persons or consequences, sometimes negative)
BDAG.pt: tendo um grau elevado de valor ou mérito comparável, correspondente, comparável, digno (de preço ou relação); adequadamente apropriado ou compatível, digno, merecedor (de pessoas ou consequências, às vezes negativo)

DEFINITION: to account or treat as worthy.
ORIGIN: From axios; to deem entitled or fit.

BDAG.en: to consider suitable for requital or receipt, consider worthy, deserving; to make an evaluation concerning suitability, deem, hold an opinion, request, ask
BDAG.pt: considerar adequado para retribuição ou recebimento, considerar digno, merecedor; fazer uma avaliação sobre a adequação, julgar, ter uma opinião, solicitar, pedir

DEFINITION: worthily, in a manner worthy of.
ORIGIN: Adverb from axios; appropriately.
USAGE: as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy).

BDAG.en: worthily, in a manner worthy of, suitably
BDAG.pt: dignamente, de maneira digna de, apropriadamente

DEFINITION: unseen, invisible.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and horatos; invisible.

BDAG.en: unseen, invisible, pertaining to not being subject to sight (of God, Christ, or the invisible world).
BDAG.pt: invisível, não sujeito à visão (referente a Deus, Cristo ou o mundo invisível).

DEFINITION: to report (from one place to another), bring a report, announce, declare.
ORIGIN: From apo and the base of aggelos; to announce.
USAGE: bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell.

BDAG.en: to give an account of, report back, announce, tell; to make something known publicly, proclaim.
BDAG.pt: dar um relato, relatar, anunciar, contar; tornar algo conhecido publicamente, proclamar.

DEFINITION: to choke, strangle; mid: to strangle or hang myself.
ORIGIN: From apo and agcho (to choke; akin to the base of agkale); to strangle oneself off (i.e. To death).

BDAG.en: mid. hang oneself
BDAG.pt: enforcar-se (voz média)

DEFINITION: to lead, carry, take away; met: to be led astray, seduced.
ORIGIN: From apo and ago; to take off (in various senses).
USAGE: bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away.

BDAG.en: to lead or move away, lead off, take away; in legal context: to bring before (a judge/authority), to lead away a prisoner/condemned man; metaphorically: to be misled or carried away.
BDAG.pt: levar ou mover para longe, conduzir para fora, retirar; em contexto legal: apresentar (a um juiz/autoridade), levar um prisioneiro/condenado; metaforicamente: ser enganado ou arrastado.

DEFINITION: untrained, uneducated, showing a want of training or education, ignorant.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a derivative of paideuo; uninstructed, i.e. (figuratively) stupid.

BDAG.en: uninstructed, uneducated
BDAG.pt: não instruído, sem educação

DEFINITION: to take away, remove; pass: to be taken away, withdrawn.
ORIGIN: From apo and airo; to lift off, i.e. Remove.

BDAG.en: trans. take away; intr. go on a journey, depart, leave
BDAG.pt: transitivo: levar embora; intransitivo: empreender uma viagem, partir, deixar

DEFINITION: to ask back, ask what is due, demand back.
ORIGIN: From apo and aiteo; to demand back.

BDAG.en: to demand something back or as due, ask for, demand (of a loan or stolen property); generally to ask for with urgency, demand, desire
BDAG.pt: exigir de volta ou como devido, pedir, demandar (de um empréstimo ou propriedade roubada); em geral, pedir com urgência, exigir, desejar

DEFINITION: (lit: to cease to feel [my] pain), be past feeling, cease to care (suggesting sometimes despair, sometimes recklessness), become callous, reckless.
ORIGIN: From apo and algeo (to smart); to grieve out, i.e. Become apathetic.

BDAG.en: to become callous, dead to feeling, without a sense of right and wrong; to be filled with a heavy sense of loss or deprivation, be despondent
BDAG.pt: tornar-se insensível, morto ao sentimento, sem senso de certo e errado; estar cheio de um forte sentimento de perda ou privação, ficar desanimado

DEFINITION: to free (a person) from (anything), oftener in the middle voice: to be released from, be rid of (a person or thing), depart.
ORIGIN: From apo and allasso; to change away, i.e. Release, (reflexively) remove.

BDAG.en: to set free from a controlling state or entity, free, release; to go away, leave, depart; to settle a matter with an adversary, come to a settlement, be quit of
BDAG.pt: libertar de um estado ou entidade controladora, libertar, soltar; ir embora, partir, retirar-se; resolver uma questão com um adversário, chegar a um acordo, livrar-se de

DEFINITION: to estrange, alienate; pass: to be alienated from.
ORIGIN: From apo and a derivative of allotrios; to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant.

DEFINITION: soft, tender, as a shoot of a tree.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain derivation; soft.

BDAG.en: tender (not hard or tough)
BDAG.pt: tenro (não duro ou rijo)

DEFINITION: to go to meet, meet, encounter.
ORIGIN: From apo and a derivative of anti; to meet away, i.e. Encounter.

BDAG.en: meet
BDAG.pt: encontrar, ir ao encontro

DEFINITION: the act of meeting, to meet (a phrase seemingly almost technical for the reception of a newly arrived official).
ORIGIN: From apantao; a (friendly) encounter.

BDAG.en: meeting (only in the formula εἰς ἀπάντησιν, to meet)
BDAG.pt: encontro (somente na fórmula εἰς ἀπάντησιν, para encontrar)

DEFINITION: once, once for all.
ORIGIN: Probably from hapas; one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively).

BDAG.en: once (as a numer. term pert. to a single occurrence); once and for all (pert. to a single occurrence and decisively unique).
BDAG.pt: uma vez (como um termo numérico referente a uma única ocorrência); de uma vez por todas (referente a uma ocorrência única e decisivamente singular).

DEFINITION: inviolable, unchangeable.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a derivative of parabaino; not passing away, i.e. Untransferable (perpetual).

BDAG.en: permanent, unchangeable (usu. interpr. ‘without a successor’ in Hb 7:24, but this meaning is not found elsewhere).
BDAG.pt: permanente, imutável (usualmente interpretado como ‘sem sucessor’ em Hb 7:24, mas este significado não é encontrado em outros lugares).

DEFINITION: unprepared.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a derivative of paraskeuazo; unready.

BDAG.en: not ready, unprepared (actually a military term).
BDAG.pt: não pronto, despreparado (na verdade um termo militar).

DEFINITION: to deny, disown, repudiate (either another person or myself), disregard.
ORIGIN: From apo and arneomai; to deny utterly, i.e. Disown, abstain.

BDAG.en: deny (to refuse to recognize/acknowledge); deny oneself (to act in a wholly selfless manner).
BDAG.pt: negar (recusar-se a reconhecer/admitir); negar-se a si mesmo (agir de maneira completamente abnegada).

DEFINITION: from henceforth.
ORIGIN: From apo and arti; from now, i.e. Henceforth (already).

BDAG.en: just now, even now.
BDAG.pt: agora mesmo, ainda agora.

DEFINITION: completion, perfection.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of aparti; completion.

BDAG.en: completion.
BDAG.pt: conclusão, finalização.

DEFINITION: the first-fruits, the earliest crop of the year, hence also met., for example, of the earliest converts in a district; there is evidence in favor of rendering in some passages merely by: sacrifice, gift.
ORIGIN: From a compound of apo and archomai; a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. The (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively).

BDAG.en: first fruits, first portion of any kind (cultic term); fig. first fruits of Christians (the first converts); the first of those who have fallen asleep (of Christ); foretaste of things to come (of the Spirit).
BDAG.pt: primícias, primeira porção de qualquer tipo (termo cultual); fig. primícias de cristãos (os primeiros convertidos); o primeiro dentre os que adormeceram (de Cristo); antegosto das coisas vindouras (do Espírito).

DEFINITION: all, the whole, altogether.
ORIGIN: From a (as a particle of union) and pas; absolutely all or (singular) every one.

BDAG.en: whole, all (used w. a subst. and the art.); all, everybody, everything (without a subst.).
BDAG.pt: todo, a totalidade (usado com um substantivo e o artigo); todos, todos, tudo (sem um substantivo).

DEFINITION: to deceive, cheat, lead into error.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain derivation; to cheat, i.e. Delude.

BDAG.en: deceive, mislead; enjoy oneself, live pleasurably (middle voice).
BDAG.pt: enganar, iludir; divertir-se, viver prazerosamente (voz média).

DEFINITION: deceit, deception, deceitfulness, delusion.
ORIGIN: From apatao; delusion.

BDAG.en: deception, deceitfulness (the seduction which comes from wealth); pleasure, pleasantness that involves one in sin.
BDAG.pt: engano, falsidade (a sedução que provém da riqueza); prazer, deleite que envolve em pecado.

DEFINITION: without (recorded) father, of unknown father.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and pater; fatherless, i.e. Of unrecorded paternity.

BDAG.en: fatherless, without a father (used of Melchizedek).
BDAG.pt: orfão de pai, sem pai (usado para Melquisedeque).

DEFINITION: a light flashing forth (from), radiation, gleam.
ORIGIN: From a compound of apo and augazo; an off-flash, i.e. Effulgence.

BDAG.en: actual radiance, effulgence, in the sense of brightness from a source; reflection, i.e. brightness shining back.
BDAG.pt: Radiância real, fulgor, no sentido de brilho vindo de uma fonte; reflexo, ou seja, brilho que irradia de volta.

DEFINITION: see.
ORIGIN: From apo and the same as eido; to see fully.

DEFINITION: willful unbelief, obstinacy, disobedience.
ORIGIN: From apeithes; disbelief (obstinate and rebellious).

BDAG.en: disobedience, always of disobedience toward God; sometimes with the connotation of disbelief in the Christian gospel.
BDAG.pt: Desobediência, sempre em relação a Deus; às vezes com a conotação de descrença no evangelho cristão.

DEFINITION: to disobey, rebel, be disloyal, refuse conformity.
ORIGIN: From apeithes; to disbelieve (wilfully and perversely).
USAGE: not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.

BDAG.en: disobey, be disobedient (always toward God, God’s ordinances, or revelation).
BDAG.pt: Desobedecer, ser desobediente (sempre em relação a Deus, às ordenanças de Deus ou à revelação).

DEFINITION: unbelieving, disobedient, who will not be persuaded.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and peitho; unpersuadable, i.e. Contumacious.

BDAG.en: disobedient (to parents, or to the heavenly vision).
BDAG.pt: Desobediente (aos pais, ou à visão celestial).

DEFINITION: to threaten, forbid by threatening.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain derivation; to menace; by implication, to forbid.

BDAG.en: threaten, warn (someone), warn (them) no longer to.
BDAG.pt: Ameaçar, advertir (alguém), advertir (que não o façam mais).

DEFINITION: a threatening, threat.
ORIGIN: From apeileo; a menace.

BDAG.en: threat.
BDAG.pt: Ameaça.

DEFINITION: to be away, to be absent.
ORIGIN: From apo and eimi; to be away.

BDAG.en: II. to move from a position, go away, go, come, go away from something; simply go, come.
BDAG.pt: II. Mover-se de uma posição, afastar-se, ir, vir; simplesmente ir, chegar.

DEFINITION: to go away, depart.
ORIGIN: From apo and eimi (to go); to go away.

BDAG.en: II. to move from a position, go away, go, come, go away from something; simply go, come.
BDAG.pt: II. Mover-se de uma posição, afastar-se, ir, vir; simplesmente ir, chegar.

DEFINITION: to renounce, disown, forbid, refuse.
ORIGIN: Reflexive past of a compound of apo and epo; to say off for oneself, i.e. Disown.

BDAG.en: forbid; disown, renounce.
BDAG.pt: Proibir; renegar, renunciar.

DEFINITION: untried, inexperienced, untempted, incapable of being tempted.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of peirao; untried, i.e. Not temptable.

BDAG.en: without temptation, either active = who does not tempt, or passive = who cannot be tempted. Of God.
BDAG.pt: Sem tentação, seja ativo = quem não tenta, ou passivo = quem não pode ser tentado. De Deus.

DEFINITION: inexperienced, unskillful, ignorant.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and peira; inexperienced, i.e. Ignorant.

BDAG.en: II. boundless.
BDAG.pt: II. Ilimitado, sem limites.

DEFINITION: to expect eagerly, wait for eagerly, look for.
ORIGIN: From apo and ekdechomai; to expect fully.

BDAG.en: await eagerly; in our lit. always of Christian hope with its various objects.
BDAG.pt: Aguardar ansiosamente; na nossa literatura, sempre se refere à esperança cristã com seus vários objetos.

DEFINITION: to strip, divest, renounce.
ORIGIN: Middle voice from apo and ekduo; to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil.

BDAG.en: 1. take off, strip off of clothes (only fig.); 2. disarm.
BDAG.pt: 1. Tirar, despir-se de roupas (somente figurado); 2. Desarmar.

DEFINITION: a putting off (as of a garment), a casting off.
ORIGIN: From apekduomai; divestment.

BDAG.en: removal, stripping off of clothes; only fig.
BDAG.pt: Remoção, ato de despir-se de roupas; somente figurado.

DEFINITION: to drive away.
ORIGIN: From apo and elauno; to dismiss.

BDAG.en: drive away.
BDAG.pt: Afastar, expulsar.

DEFINITION: refutation, rejection, hence: disrepute, contempt.
ORIGIN: From a compound of apo and elegcho; refutation, i.e. (by implication) contempt.

BDAG.en: criticism relating to questionable conduct, refutation, exposure, discredit
BDAG.pt: Crítica referente a conduta questionável, refutação, exposição, descrédito.

DEFINITION: a freedman, one who has been a slave but has been manumitted by his master.
ORIGIN: From apo and eleutheros; one freed away, i.e. A freedman.

BDAG.en: freedperson; fig., of Christians a freedperson of the Lord.
BDAG.pt: Liberto; figurativamente, de cristãos, um liberto do Senhor.

DEFINITION: Apelles, a Christian (man) in Rome.
ORIGIN: Of Latin origin; Apelles, a Christian.

BDAG.en: Apelles, greeted in Ro 16:10.
BDAG.pt: Apeles, saudado em Romanos 16:10.

DEFINITION: to give up in despair, despair of; to hope to receive from or in return.
ORIGIN: From apo and elpizo; to hope out, i.e. Fully expect.

BDAG.en: 1. despair (absolutely, or despair of oneself); 2. expect back (lend, expecting nothing in return).
BDAG.pt: 1. Desesperar (absolutamente, ou desesperar de si mesmo); 2. Esperar receber de volta (emprestar, não esperando nada em troca).

DEFINITION: against, over against, opposite, in view of, in the presence of.
ORIGIN: From apo and enanti; from in front, i.e. Opposite, before or against.
USAGE: before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.

BDAG.en: 1. in a position that faces against an object or other position, opposite (as adverb or preposition with genitive); 2. marker of hostility or strong opposition, against, contrary to.
BDAG.pt: 1. Em uma posição que se confronta com um objeto ou outra posição, em frente (como advérbio ou preposição com genitivo); 2. Marcador de hostilidade ou forte oposição, contra, em oposição a.

DEFINITION: unaccomplished, unending, endless.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of peran; unfinished, i.e. (by implication) interminable.

BDAG.en: endless, limitless
BDAG.pt: interminável, ilimitado

DEFINITION: without distraction, without being distracted.
ORIGIN: Adverb from a compound of a (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of perispao; undistractedly, i.e. Free from (domestic) solicitude.

BDAG.en: without distraction
BDAG.pt: Sem distração.

DEFINITION: uncircumcised.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of peritemno; uncircumcised (figuratively).

BDAG.en: 1 lit. uncircumcised; 2 fig. obdurate
BDAG.pt: 1 literalmente incircunciso; 2 figurativamente obstinado/endurecido

DEFINITION: to come or go away from, depart, return, arrive, go after, follow.
ORIGIN: From apo and erchomai; to go off (i.e. Depart), aside (i.e. Apart) or behind (i.e. Follow), literally or figuratively.
USAGE: come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out,... Ways), pass away, be past.

BDAG.en: to move from a ref. point, of pers. or things a go away, depart; b go (opp. ἐξέρχεται) w. indication of place; 2 to discontinue as a condition or state, of diseases, etc.; Gener. pass away; 3 to go from a source and spread out, go out, of a message; 4 to endeavor to attain someth., go after; 5 to abandon an association w. someone, go off, go away, leave; 6 idiom, to leave a place to become an adherent of someone, go after, follow someone
BDAG.pt: mover-se de um ponto de referência, de pessoas ou coisas: a ir embora, partir; b ir (oposto a sair) com indicação de lugar; 2 descontinuar como condição ou estado, de doenças, etc.; gerar-se, passar; 3 sair de uma fonte e espalhar-se, sair, de uma mensagem; 4 esforçar-se para alcançar algo, ir atrás; 5 abandonar uma associação com alguém, ir embora, deixar; 6 expressão idiomática, deixar um lugar para se tornar um adepto de alguém, ir atrás, seguir alguém

DEFINITION: it is enough.
ORIGIN: Third person singular present indicative active of apecho used impersonally; it is sufficient.

BDAG.en: to meet the need of the moment, to suffice, be enough
BDAG.pt: satisfazer a necessidade do momento, ser suficiente, bastar

DEFINITION: to abstain from, keep myself away from.
ORIGIN: Middle voice (reflexively) of apecho; to hold oneself off, i.e. Refrain.

DEFINITION: to hold back, keep off, to be away, be distant.
ORIGIN: From apo and echo; (actively) to have out, i.e. Receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. Be distant (literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: 1 to receive in full what is due, to be paid in full, receive in full, act., commercial t.t.; 2 to meet the need of the moment, to suffice, be enough; 4 to be at some distance from a position, be distant, intr.; 5 to avoid contact w. or use of someth., keep away, abstain, refrain from mid. w. gen. of thing
BDAG.pt: 1 receber integralmente o que é devido, ser pago integralmente, receber totalmente, ativo, termo comercial; 2 satisfazer a necessidade do momento, ser suficiente, bastar; 4 estar a alguma distância de uma posição, estar distante, intransitivo; 5 evitar o contato ou uso de algo, manter distância, abster-se, refrear no meio com genitivo da coisa

DEFINITION: to be unfaithful, disbelieve, refuse belief, prove false.
ORIGIN: From apistos; to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey.

BDAG.en: 1 disbelieve, refuse to believe, intr. a gener.; 2 not believe in someone, trans.; 3 be unfaithful of one lacking a sense of obligation
BDAG.pt: 1 descrer, recusar-se a crer, intransitivo em geral; 2 não crer em alguém, transitivo; 3 ser infiel, de alguém que carece de senso de obrigação

DEFINITION: unbelief, unfaithfulness, distrust.
ORIGIN: From apistos; faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience).

BDAG.en: 1 unwillingness to commit oneself to another or respond positively to the other’s words or actions, lack of belief, unbelief; 2 lack of commitment to a relationship or pledge, unfaithfulness
BDAG.pt: 1 falta de disposição para se comprometer com o outro ou responder positivamente às palavras ou ações do outro, falta de crença, incredulidade; 2 falta de compromisso com um relacionamento ou promessa, infidelidade

DEFINITION: unbelieving, incredulous, unchristian; sometimes subst: unbeliever.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and pistos; (actively) disbelieving, i.e. Without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing).
USAGE: that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing).

BDAG.en: 1 unbelievable, incredible; 2 without faith, disbelieving, unbelieving
BDAG.pt: 1 inacreditável, incrível; 2 sem fé, descrente, incrédulo

DEFINITION: simplicity, sincerity, purity, graciousness.
ORIGIN: From haplous; singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal).

BDAG.en: singleness. In our lit. esp. of personal integrity expressed in word or action... simplicity, sincerity, uprightness, frankness... Of simple goodness, which gives itself without reserve... ingenuousness
BDAG.pt: Singeleza. Em nossa literatura, especialmente integridade pessoal expressa em palavras ou ações... simplicidade, sinceridade, retidão, franqueza... De bondade simples, que se entrega sem reservas... ingenuidade

DEFINITION: single, simple, sound, perfect.
ORIGIN: Probably from a (as a particle of union) and the base of pleko; properly, folded together, i.e. Single (figuratively, clear).

BDAG.en: pert. to being motivated by singleness of purpose so as to be open and aboveboard, single, without guile, sincere, straightforward i.e. without a hidden agenda... Of the eye single = unjaundiced, sincere... quite simple, guileless, of doves
BDAG.pt: Pertinente a ser motivado por um propósito singular, de modo a ser aberto e transparente, simples, sem engano, sincero, direto, ou seja, sem segundas intenções... Do olho, simples = sem inveja, sincero... muito simples, ingênuo, de pombas

DEFINITION: simply, sincerely, graciously, bountifully.
ORIGIN: Adverb from haplous (in the objective sense of haplotes); bountifully.

BDAG.en: pert. to being straightforward, simply, above board, sincerely, openly... in short, in a word... simply, at all w. neg. expr.
BDAG.pt: Pertinente a ser direto, simplesmente, abertamente, sinceramente... em resumo, em poucas palavras... simplesmente, de modo algum com expressão negativa

DEFINITION: from, away from.
ORIGIN: A primary particle; "off," i.e. Away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative).
USAGE: (X here-)after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for(-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-)on(-ce), since, with. In composition (as a prefix) it usually denotes separation, departure, cessation, completion, reversal, etc.

BDAG.en: denoting motion, esp. those compounded with ἀπό: ... but also with ...; ... with all verbs expressing the idea of separation ...; ... with verbs which express the concept of separation in the wider sense, like loose, free, acquit et al.; ... verbs meaning be on guard, be ashamed, etc., take ἀπό to express the occasion or object of their caution, shame, or fear; ... with verbs of concealing, hiding, hindering, the person from whom something is concealed is found with ἀπό; ... in pregnant construction like ... be separated from Christ by a curse ...; as a substitute for the partitive genitive ...; to indicate the point from which something begins, whether lit. or fig. ... of place from, out from ...; ... of time from ... (on), since ...; ... the beginning of a series from ... (on) ...; ... w. both beginning and end given ...; ... to indicate origin or source, from a lit., with verbs of motion ... down from ...; ... from ...; ... lit., to indicate someone’s local origin from ...; ... fig., w. verbs of asking, desiring, to denote the person of or from whom a thing is asked ...; ... fig., w. verbs of perceiving, to indicate source of the perception ...; ... write from what I was able, i.e. as well as I could ...; to indicate distance from a point, away from, for ...; with detailed measurements ...; Hebraistically ... from the presence of someone ...; to indicate cause, means, or outcome ... gener., to show the reason for something because of, as a result of, for ...; to indicate means with the help of, with ...; to indicate motive or reason for, from, with ...; to indicate originator of the action denoted by the verb from ...; ... to indicate responsible agents for something, from, of ... the self, st. Gk. usage ... fr. others. ... In such cases ἀπό freq. denotes the one who indirectly originates an action, and can be transl. at the hands of, by command of: ... In ἀ. θεοῦπειράζομαι the thought is that the temptation is caused by God, though not actually carried out by God ...; In a few expr. ἀπό helps to take the place of an adverb.
BDAG.pt: denotando movimento, especialmente aqueles compostos com ἀπό: ... mas também com ...; ... com todos os verbos que expressam a ideia de separação ...; ... com verbos que expressam o conceito de separação em sentido mais amplo, como soltar, libertar, absolver etc.; ... verbos que significam estar em guarda, ter vergonha, etc., usam ἀπό para expressar a ocasião ou objeto de sua cautela, vergonha ou medo; ... com verbos de ocultar, esconder, impedir, a pessoa de quem algo é ocultado é encontrada com ἀπό; ... em construção pregnant like ... ser separado de Cristo por uma maldição ...; como substituto do genitivo partitivo ...; para indicar o ponto de onde algo começa, seja literal ou figurado ... do lugar, de, para fora de ...; ... do tempo, desde ... (em diante), desde ...; ... o começo de uma série a partir de ... (em diante) ...; ... com começo e fim dados ...; ... para indicar origem ou fonte, de, literalmente, com verbos de movimento ... para baixo de ...; ... de ...; ... literalmente, para indicar a origem local de alguém de ...; ... figurado, com verbos de pedir, desejar, para denotar a pessoa de ou de quem algo é pedido ...; ... figurado, com verbos de percepção, para indicar a fonte da percepção ...; ... escrever do que eu fui capaz, ou seja, o melhor que pude ...; para indicar distância de um ponto, longe de, para ...; com medidas detalhadas ...; Hebraisticamente ... da presença de alguém ...; para indicar causa, meio ou resultado ... geral, para mostrar a razão de algo, por causa de, como resultado de, para ...; para indicar meio com a ajuda de, com ...; para indicar motivo ou razão para, de, com ...; para indicar o originador da ação denotada pelo verbo de ...; ... para indicar agentes responsáveis por algo, de, de ... o si mesmo, uso grego padrão ... de outros. ... Nestes casos ἀπό frequentemente denota aquele que indiretamente origina uma ação, e pode ser traduzido nas mãos de, por ordem de: ... Em ἀ. θεοῦπειράζομαι o pensamento é que a tentação é causada por Deus, embora não executada por Deus ...; Em algumas expressões ἀπό ajuda a tomar o lugar de um advérbio.

DEFINITION: to go or come out of, disembark, turn out, result, become, happen.
ORIGIN: From apo and the base of basis; literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate.

BDAG.en: to get off or depart, go away, get out e.g. from a ship to the land; fig. to result in a state or condition, turn out, lead (to)
BDAG.pt: sair ou partir, ir embora, descer (de um navio para a terra); figurado, resultar em um estado ou condição, dar como resultado, conduzir (a)

DEFINITION: to throw away from, throw overboard, cast aside.
ORIGIN: From apo and ballo; to throw off; figuratively, to lose.

BDAG.en: to remove something that is affixed or an established part, take off, shed (a garment); fig. take off, doff (of characteristics); to get rid of as undesirable or substandard, throw away, reject; to come to be without something, lose something; to remove from an official position, remove, depose
BDAG.pt: remover algo que está fixado ou é parte estabelecida, tirar, desprender (uma vestimenta); figurado, tirar, livrar-se de (características); livrar-se de algo indesejável ou de qualidade inferior, jogar fora, rejeitar; vir a ficar sem algo, perder algo; remover de uma posição oficial, destituir, depor

DEFINITION: to look away from all else at one object, look steadfastly.
ORIGIN: From apo and blepo; to look away from everything else, i.e. (figuratively) intently regard.

BDAG.en: look, pay attention at or to something; fig., intent on the reward
BDAG.pt: olhar, prestar atenção em algo; figurado, focado na recompensa

DEFINITION: worthy to be cast away, worthless, regarded as vile.
ORIGIN: From apoballo; cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected.

BDAG.en: rejected, unclean
BDAG.pt: rejeitado, impuro

DEFINITION: a casting away, rejection, a loss.
ORIGIN: From apoballo; rejection; figuratively, loss.

BDAG.en: rejection (of Israelites by God); loss (by death, of a ship, etc.)
BDAG.pt: rejeição (dos israelitas por Deus); perda (por morte, de um navio, etc.)

DEFINITION: to be away, be removed from, depart life, die.
ORIGIN: Past participle of a compound of apo and ginomai; absent, i.e. Deceased (figuratively, renounced).

BDAG.en: die (in our literature opposed to living)
BDAG.pt: morrer (na nossa literatura oposto a viver)

DEFINITION: an enrollment, census-taking, record.
ORIGIN: From apographo; an enrollment; by implication, an assessment.

BDAG.en: list, inventory, census, registration (of citizens for tax/family records)
BDAG.pt: lista, inventário, censo, registro (de cidadãos para registros fiscais/familiares)

DEFINITION: to enroll, inscribe in a register; mid: to give name for registration (or census-taking).
ORIGIN: From apo and grapho; to write off (a copy or list), i.e. Enrol.

BDAG.en: to copy, to enter into a list, register, register (oneself), of records kept by God (the Book of Life).
BDAG.pt: copiar, inscrever em uma lista, registrar, registrar (a si mesmo), de registros mantidos por Deus (o Livro da Vida).

DEFINITION: to show by proof, demonstrate, set forth, proclaim to an officer.
ORIGIN: From apo and deiknuo; to show off, i.e. Exhibit; figuratively, to demonstrate, i.e. Accredit.

BDAG.en: to point away and direct attention to, to show forth for public recognition, make, render, proclaim, appoint, to show forth the quality of an entity, display, to demonstrate that something is true, prove, to draw attention to a specific object, show.
BDAG.pt: apontar para longe e chamar a atenção para, mostrar para reconhecimento público, fazer, tornar, proclamar, nomear, manifestar a qualidade de uma entidade, exibir, demonstrar que algo é verdadeiro, provar, chamar a atenção para um objeto específico, mostrar.

DEFINITION: demonstration, proof; a showing off.
ORIGIN: From apodeiknumi; manifestation.

BDAG.en: a pointing away for the purpose of demonstration, proof (especially of divine intervention), proof of spirit and power.
BDAG.pt: um apontar para um propósito de demonstração, prova (especialmente de intervenção divina), prova de espírito e poder.

DEFINITION: to take off (deduct) a tenth part (of property) (and give it away), pay tithe.
ORIGIN: From apo and dekatoo; to tithe (as debtor or creditor).

BDAG.en: to give one tenth, tithe (of something); to collect one tenth, collect a tithe (from someone)
BDAG.pt: dar um décimo, dizimar (de algo); coletar um décimo, cobrar o dízimo (de alguém)

DEFINITION: worthy to be received (welcomed), acceptable, welcome, pleasant.
ORIGIN: From apodechomai; accepted, i.e. Agreeable.

BDAG.en: acceptable, welcome (or pleasing, depending on accentuation).
BDAG.pt: aceitável, bem-vindo (ou agradável, dependendo da acentuação).

DEFINITION: to receive, welcome, entertain (with hospitality), embrace.
ORIGIN: From apo and dechomai; to take fully, i.e. Welcome (persons), approve (things).

BDAG.en: to receive or accept someone or something from a source, receive someone favorably, welcome, show approval by accepting, accept something, approve or commend as praiseworthy, recognize, acknowledge, praise someone or something.
BDAG.pt: receber ou aceitar alguém ou algo de uma fonte, receber alguém favoravelmente, dar as boas-vindas, mostrar aprovação aceitando, aceitar algo, aprovar ou recomendar como louvável, reconhecer, reconhecer, louvar alguém ou algo.

DEFINITION: to be away from home, go into another country, be away, be abroad.
ORIGIN: From apodemos; to go abroad, i.e. Visit a foreign land.
USAGE: go (travel) into a far country, journey.

BDAG.en: to travel away from one's domicile, go on a journey; fig., euphemistically, to be absent from the flesh=die; to be distant from, be away, absent
BDAG.pt: viajar para longe do domicílio, fazer uma jornada; figurado, eufemisticamente, estar ausente da carne=morrer; estar distante de, estar ausente

DEFINITION: away from home, sojourning in another country.
ORIGIN: From apo and demos; absent from one's own people, i.e. A foreign traveller.

BDAG.en: away from one's deme (district in a city-state); away, absent
BDAG.pt: longe do seu demo (distrito em uma cidade-estado); ausente, afastado

DEFINITION: (a) to give back, return, restore, (b) to give, render, as due, (c) mid: to sell.
ORIGIN: From apo and didomi; to give away, i.e. Up, over, back, etc. (in various applications).
USAGE: deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield.

BDAG.en: to give out, give, give up, yield, award a crown, meet a contractual or other obligation, pay, pay out, fulfill, give testimony, pay taxes, fulfill various responsibilities, restore to an original possessor, give back, return, recompense (good or bad), make an exchange, sell, trade.
BDAG.pt: dar, entregar, ceder, premiar com uma coroa, cumprir uma obrigação contratual ou outra, pagar, liquidar, cumprir, dar testemunho, pagar impostos, cumprir várias responsabilidades, restaurar ao possuidor original, devolver, recompensar (bom ou mau), fazer uma troca, vender, negociar.

DEFINITION: to make a logical distinction, make an invidious distinction.
ORIGIN: From apo and a compound of Alexandros and horizo; to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party).

BDAG.en: mark off by dividing or separating, hence divide, separate (in reference to persons)
BDAG.pt: demarcar por divisão ou separação, consequentemente dividir, separar (em referência a pessoas)

DEFINITION: to reject after testing (examination), disqualify.
ORIGIN: From apo and dokimazo; to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate.

BDAG.en: to reject (after scrutiny), declare useless, regard as unworthy/unfit and therefore to be rejected, reject (of things or persons), be rejected by God.
BDAG.pt: rejeitar (após exame), declarar inútil, considerar indigno/inapto e, portanto, a ser rejeitado, rejeitar (coisas ou pessoas), ser rejeitado por Deus.

DEFINITION: (properly: reception, welcome, of guests), acceptance, appreciation, approbation.
ORIGIN: From apodechomai; acceptance.

BDAG.en: acceptance, approval (of a saying).
BDAG.pt: aceitação, aprovação (de uma afirmação).

DEFINITION: a putting off, a laying down.
ORIGIN: From apotithemi; a laying aside (literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: removal, getting rid of (figuratively, of dirt in baptism, or euphemistically for death).
BDAG.pt: remoção, livrar-se (figurativamente, da sujeira no batismo, ou eufemisticamente para a morte).

DEFINITION: a repository, granary, barn, storehouse.
ORIGIN: From apotithemi; a repository, i.e. Granary.

BDAG.en: storehouse, barn (place where one puts something), gather into the barn.
BDAG.pt: armazém, celeiro (lugar onde se guarda algo), ajuntar no celeiro.

DEFINITION: to treasure up, store away.
ORIGIN: From apo and thesaurizo; to treasure away.

BDAG.en: store up, lay up fig.
BDAG.pt: armazenar, guardar (sentido figurado).

DEFINITION: (lit: to rub), jostle, press hard, crowd.
ORIGIN: From apo and thlibo; to crowd (from every side).

BDAG.en: to apply squeezing pressure, press upon, crowd
BDAG.pt: aplicar pressão esmagadora, apertar, comprimir (por uma multidão).

DEFINITION: to be dying, be about to die, wither, decay.
ORIGIN: From apo and thnesko; to die off (literally or figuratively).
USAGE: be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).

BDAG.en: intensive of θνῄσκω ‘die’. 1 to cease to have vital functions, whether at an earthly or transcendent level, die a of death on an earthly level... Of violent death... fig. b of death on a transcendent level... 2 the prospect of death or realization of mortality be about to die, face death, be mortal
BDAG.pt: morrer (intensivo de θνῄσκω). 1 cessar as funções vitais, seja a nível terreno ou transcendente, morrer (a nível terreno)... De morte violenta... b de morte transcendente (perder a vida eterna)... 2 estar prestes a morrer, enfrentar a morte, ser mortal.

DEFINITION: to set up again, restore to its original position or condition; hence: to restore, give back.
ORIGIN: From apo and kathistemi; to reconstitute (in health, home or organization).

DEFINITION: to uncover, bring to light, reveal.
ORIGIN: From apo and kalupto; to take off the cover, i.e. Disclose.

BDAG.en: to cause something to be fully known, reveal, disclose, bring to light, make fully known; be revealed; especially of divine revelation of certain transcendent secrets; impart a revelation to someone; of the interpretation of prophetic visions; of the revelation of certain persons and circumstances in the endtime.
BDAG.pt: fazer algo ser totalmente conhecido, revelar, divulgar, trazer à luz, dar a conhecer plenamente; ser revelado; especialmente de revelação divina de certos segredos transcendentais; conferir uma revelação a alguém; da interpretação de visões proféticas; da revelação de certas pessoas e circunstâncias no fim dos tempos.

DEFINITION: an unveiling, uncovering, revealing, revelation.
ORIGIN: From apokalupto; disclosure.
USAGE: appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.

BDAG.en: making fully known, revelation, disclosure a of the revelation of truth gener.... of revelations of a particular kind, through visions, etc.... of the disclosure of secrets belonging to the last days... as part of a book title Revelation
BDAG.pt: tornar plenamente conhecido, revelação, divulgação, a. da revelação da verdade em geral... de revelações de um tipo particular, através de visões, etc.... da revelação de segredos pertencentes aos últimos dias... como parte do título de um livro (Apocalipse).

DEFINITION: strained expectancy.
ORIGIN: From a comparative of apo and a compound of kara (the head) and dokeo (in the sense of watching); intense anticipation.

BDAG.en: eager expectation
BDAG.pt: expectativa ansiosa/ardente.

DEFINITION: to reconcile, change from one state of feeling to another.
ORIGIN: From apo and katallasso; to reconcile fully.

BDAG.en: reconcile
BDAG.pt: reconciliar.

DEFINITION: restitution, reestablishment, restoration.
ORIGIN: From apokathistemi; reconstitution.

BDAG.en: restoration, which can be var. understood
BDAG.pt: restauração, que pode ser entendida de várias maneiras.

DEFINITION: to have been put away, be stored, be reserved for.
ORIGIN: From apo and keimai; to be reserved; figuratively, to await.

BDAG.en: used as pass. of ἀποτίθημι ‘be put away, stored up’ 1 to put away for safekeeping lit.... 2 to reserve as award or recompense, reserve... 3 Impers. ἀπόκειταί τινι it is unavoidable in view of inevitable circumstance, it is certain, one is destined
BDAG.pt: usado como passivo de ἀποτίθημι, ‘ser guardado, armazenado’. 1 guardar para salvaguarda (sentido literal)... 2 reservar como prêmio ou recompensa, reservar... 3 impessoal: é inevitável, é certo, está destinado.

DEFINITION: to behead.
ORIGIN: From apo and kephale; to decapitate.

BDAG.en: behead.
BDAG.pt: decapitar.

DEFINITION: to shut fast, close, shut up.
ORIGIN: From apo and kleio; to close fully.

BDAG.en: close, shut.
BDAG.pt: fechar, trancar.

DEFINITION: to smite, cut off, cut loose; mid: to emasculate, castrate, mutilate myself.
ORIGIN: From apo and kopto; to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts).

BDAG.en: to cut so as to make a separation, cut off, cut away; (of private parts) make a eunuch of, castrate; of noncorporal things: cut the ropes, branches in pruning procedure, building-stones
BDAG.pt: cortar de modo a separar, cortar fora, amputar; (de partes íntimas) castrar; (de coisas não corporais) cortar as cordas, galhos na poda, pedras de construção

DEFINITION: a judicial sentence, an answer.
ORIGIN: From apokrinomai (in its original sense of judging); a judicial decision.

BDAG.en: official report, decision.
BDAG.pt: relatório oficial, decisão.

DEFINITION: to answer, reply, take up the conversation.
ORIGIN: From apo and krino; to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare anah) to begin to speak (where an address is expected).

BDAG.en: answer, reply; continue (discourse); begin, speak up
BDAG.pt: responder, replicar; continuar (discurso); começar, falar

DEFINITION: an answer, reply.
ORIGIN: From apokrinomai; a response.

BDAG.en: answer.
BDAG.pt: resposta.

DEFINITION: to hide away, conceal, keep secret.
ORIGIN: From apo and krupto; to conceal away (i.e. Fully); figuratively, to keep secret.

BDAG.en: provide a hiding-place for something or someone, hide, conceal (by digging); keep from being known, keep secret.
BDAG.pt: prover um esconderijo para algo ou alguém, esconder, ocultar (cavando); manter desconhecido, manter em segredo.

DEFINITION: hidden away, secret, stored up.
ORIGIN: From apokrupto; secret; by implication, treasured.

BDAG.en: hidden; of secret wisdom.
BDAG.pt: escondido; de sabedoria secreta.

DEFINITION: to put to death, kill; fig: to abolish.
ORIGIN: From apo and kteino (to slay); to kill outright; figuratively, to destroy.

BDAG.en: to deprive of life, kill (of bodily life); commit suicide; of things as causing death; figuratively, to do away with, put to death, eliminate.
BDAG.pt: privar da vida, matar (da vida corporal); cometer suicídio; de coisas como causadoras de morte; figurativamente, eliminar, dar a morte, suprimir.

DEFINITION: to bring forth, give birth to (a child), a medical or physical word, marking the close of pregnancy.
ORIGIN: From apo and the base of kuma; to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively).

BDAG.en: give birth to (of delivery); figuratively, sin gives birth to death; God gave birth to us through the word of truth.
BDAG.pt: dar à luz (de parto); figurativamente, o pecado gera a morte; Deus nos gerou pela palavra da verdade.

DEFINITION: to roll away.
ORIGIN: From apo and kulioo; to roll away.

BDAG.en: roll away.
BDAG.pt: rolar para longe.

DEFINITION: (a) to get back, receive back, (b) to get (receive) as due (deserved), (c) mid: to draw aside, separate.
ORIGIN: From apo and lambano; to receive (specially, in full, or as a host); also to take aside.

BDAG.en: to obtain something from a source, receive; to receive back something that one previously possessed, recover, get back; to lead or take away from a particular point, take away; to accept someone’s presence with friendliness, welcome
BDAG.pt: obter algo de uma fonte, receber; receber de volta algo que se possuía anteriormente, recuperar; afastar ou retirar de um ponto particular, levar embora; aceitar a presença de alguém com amizade, acolher

DEFINITION: the faculty or experience of enjoyment.
ORIGIN: From a comparative of apo and lauo (to enjoy); full enjoyment.

BDAG.en: having the benefit of something, and so enjoying it, enjoyment; for enjoyment.
BDAG.pt: ter o benefício de algo, e assim desfrutar, usufruto; para desfrute.

DEFINITION: to leave, leave behind; pass: to be reserved, remain; to desert, abandon.
ORIGIN: From apo and leipo; to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake.

BDAG.en: to cause or permit to remain in a place upon going away, leave behind; to be reserved for future appearance or enactment, remain; to depart from a place, desert; to cease to have an interest in something, put aside, give up, leave behind, overcome.
BDAG.pt: causar ou permitir que permaneça em um lugar ao partir, deixar para trás; ser reservado para aparição ou encenação futura, permanecer; partir de um lugar, desertar; deixar de ter interesse em algo, abandonar, desistir, deixar para trás, superar.

DEFINITION: to lick off, lick clean, lick up.
ORIGIN: From apo and leicho (to "lick"); to lick clean.

BDAG.en: lick, lick off.
BDAG.pt: lamber, lamber completamente.

DEFINITION: (a) to kill, destroy, (b) to lose, mid: to be perishing (the resultant death being viewed as certain).
ORIGIN: From apo and the base of olethros; to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively.

BDAG.en: to cause or experience destruction: ruin, destroy (of persons, esp. kill, put to death; of eternal death); mid.: perish, be ruined (of persons, of things: be lost, pass away, be ruined); to fail to obtain what one expects or anticipates, lose out on, lose; to lose something that one already has or be separated from a normal connection, lose, be lost.
BDAG.pt: causar ou experimentar destruição: arruinar, destruir (de pessoas, especialmente matar, dar a morte; de morte eterna); meio: perecer, ser arruinado (de pessoas, de coisas: perder-se, passar, ser estragado); falhar em obter o que se espera ou antecipa, perder a chance, perder; perder algo que já se tem ou ser separado de uma conexão normal, perder, ser perdido.

DEFINITION: Apollyon, The Destroying One, a Greek translation of the Hebrew: Abaddon.
ORIGIN: Active participle of apollumi; a destroyer (i.e. Satan).

BDAG.en: Apollyon, the Destroyer.
BDAG.pt: Apolião, o Destruidor.

DEFINITION: Apollonia, a city in Macedonia.
ORIGIN: From the pagan deity Apollon (i.e. The sun; from apollumi); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia.

BDAG.en: Apollonia, a city in Macedonia ca. 56 km. east of Thessalonica, on the Egnatian Way.
BDAG.pt: Apolônia, uma cidade na Macedônia, a cerca de 56 km a leste de Tessalônica, na Via Egnácia.

DEFINITION: Apollos, an Alexandrian Jewish Christian.
ORIGIN: Probably from the same as Apollonia; Apollos, an Israelite.

BDAG.en: Apollos, a Christian born and educated at Alexandria, who worked in Ephesus and Corinth.
BDAG.pt: Apolo, um cristão nascido e educado em Alexandria, que trabalhou em Éfeso e Corinto.

DEFINITION: to give a defense, defend myself (especially in a law court): it can take an object of what is said in defense.
ORIGIN: Middle voice from a compound of apo and logos; to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. Exculpate (self).
USAGE: answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self.

BDAG.en: to speak in one’s own defense against charges presumed to be false, defend oneself.
BDAG.pt: Falar em defesa própria contra acusações tidas como falsas, defender-se.

DEFINITION: a verbal defense (particularly in a law court).
ORIGIN: From the same as apologeomai; a plea ("apology").
USAGE: answer (for self), clearing of self, defence.

BDAG.en: a speech of defense, defense, reply; the act of making a defense, defense (in court or generally); claim of extenuating circumstance, excuse.
BDAG.pt: Um discurso de defesa, defesa, resposta; o ato de fazer uma defesa, defesa (em tribunal ou em geral); alegação de circunstância atenuante, desculpa.

DEFINITION: to wash off, mid: to wash away (sins, in baptism).
ORIGIN: From apo and louo; to wash fully, i.e. (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively).

BDAG.en: wash something away from oneself, wash oneself, used in imagery of purification (e.g., wash away one’s sins).
BDAG.pt: Lavar algo de si mesmo, lavar-se, usado em imagens de purificação (ex: lavar os pecados).

DEFINITION: release effected by payment of ransom; redemption, deliverance.
ORIGIN: From a compound of apo and lutron; (the act) ransom in full, i.e. (figuratively) riddance, or (specially) Christian salvation.

BDAG.en: release from a painful interrogation, release, offered in return for apostasy; release from a captive condition, release, redemption, deliverance (figuratively extended to release from sin and finiteness that comes through Christ).
BDAG.pt: Libertação de um interrogatório doloroso, liberação, oferecida em troca de apostasia; libertação de uma condição de cativeiro, resgate, livramento (estendido figurativamente à libertação do pecado e da finitude que vem por Cristo).

DEFINITION: to release, let go, send away, divorce, be rid; mid: to depart.
ORIGIN: From apo and luo; to free fully, i.e. (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively, depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon or (specially) divorce.
USAGE: (let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set at liberty.

BDAG.en: As a legal term, to grant acquittal, set free, release, pardon (a prisoner); to release from a painful condition, free; to permit or cause someone to leave a particular location, let go, send away, dismiss; euphemistically for let die; to grant a request and so be rid of a person, satisfy; to dissolve a marriage relationship, to divorce; middle voice: to make a departure from a locality, go away.
BDAG.pt: Como termo legal, conceder absolvição, libertar, liberar, perdoar (um prisioneiro); libertar de uma condição dolorosa, livrar; permitir ou causar que alguém deixe um local específico, mandar embora, despedir; eufemisticamente para deixar morrer; atender a um pedido e assim livrar-se de uma pessoa, satisfazer; dissolver um vínculo matrimonial, divorciar; voz média: fazer uma partida de um local, ir embora.

DEFINITION: to wipe off, wipe clean; mid: to wipe myself off.
ORIGIN: Middle voice from apo and masso (to squeeze, knead, smear); to scrape away.

BDAG.en: wipe off, middle voice: wash oneself (as in wiping off dust in protest).
BDAG.pt: Enxugar, voz média: lavar-se (como ao sacudir o pó em protesto).

DEFINITION: to assign, apportion, render (as due).
ORIGIN: From apo and the base of nomos; to apportion, i.e. Bestow.

BDAG.en: grant what is appropriate in a relationship, assign, show, pay, accord (e.g., show honor to someone, show all respect to someone).
BDAG.pt: conceder o que é apropriado em uma relação, atribuir, mostrar, pagar, conceder (ex: mostrar honra a alguém, mostrar todo o respeito a alguém).

DEFINITION: to wash dirt off.
ORIGIN: From apo and nipto; to wash off (reflexively, one's own hands symbolically).

BDAG.en: wash off mid. (e.g., wash one's hands as a sign of innocence).
BDAG.pt: lavar (reflexivo) (ex: lavar as mãos como sinal de inocência).

DEFINITION: to fall away (from), fall off.
ORIGIN: From apo and pipto; to fall off.

BDAG.en: lit. to fall from a point or location, fall (e.g., something falling from one's eyes); fig. to depart from a norm, deviate (fall from the right way).
BDAG.pt: literalmente cair de um ponto ou local, cair (ex: algo caindo dos olhos); figurativamente desviar-se de uma norma, desviar-se (cair do caminho reto).

DEFINITION: to cause to go astray; pass: to be led astray.
ORIGIN: From apo and planao; to lead astray (figuratively); passively, to stray (from truth).

BDAG.en: mislead (only figuratively of false teachers); pass. wander away from (the faith, God, their understanding); abs. be led into error.
BDAG.pt: enganar (somente no sentido figurado de falsos mestres); passivo afastar-se (da fé, de Deus, do entendimento); absolutamente estar sendo levado ao erro.

DEFINITION: to sail away.
ORIGIN: From apo and pleo; to set sail.

BDAG.en: nautical term: sail away (to a destination).
BDAG.pt: termo náutico: navegar para longe (em direção a um destino).

DEFINITION: to wash, rinse.
ORIGIN: From apo and pluno; to rinse off.

BDAG.en: wash off/out
BDAG.pt: lavar completamente/tirar lavando

DEFINITION: (a) to suffocate, choke, drown, (b) to stop the growth of.
ORIGIN: From apo and pnigo; to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth).

BDAG.en: check normal breathing or growth through pressure or other restricting measure, choke (trans.); pass. intr. sense, drown.
BDAG.pt: impedir a respiração normal ou o crescimento por pressão ou outra medida restritiva, sufocar (transitivo); passivo com sentido intransitivo, afogar.

DEFINITION: to be at a loss, be perplexed; mid: to be in doubt.
ORIGIN: From a compound of a (as a negative particle) and the base of poreuomai; to have no way out, i.e. Be at a loss (mentally).

BDAG.en: orig. 'be without resources'; to be in a confused state of mind, be at a loss, be in doubt, be uncertain; mid. have inward debate/perplexity; abs. be at a loss.
BDAG.pt: originalmente 'estar sem recursos'; estar em um estado mental confuso, estar perdido, estar em dúvida, estar incerto; médio ter debate/perplexidade interna; absolutamente estar perdido/em apuros.

DEFINITION: perplexity, anxiety, doubt.
ORIGIN: From the same as aporeo; a (state of) quandary.

BDAG.en: orig. 'lack of means/resources'; perplexity, anxiety (anxiety because of the roaring of the sea).
BDAG.pt: originalmente 'falta de meios/recursos'; perplexidade, ansiedade (ansiedade devido ao rugido do mar).

DEFINITION: to throw away from, throw overboard.
ORIGIN: From apo and rhipto; to hurl off, i.e. Precipitate (oneself).

DEFINITION: to separate from some one, be bereaved.
ORIGIN: From apo and a derivative of orphanos; to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse).

BDAG.en: make an orphan of someone, fig., of the apostle separated from his church (made orphans by separation from you).
BDAG.pt: tornar alguém órfão, figurativamente, do apóstolo separado de sua igreja (feitos órfãos pela separação de vós).

DEFINITION: to prepare for a journey, depart.
ORIGIN: From apo and a derivative of skeuos; to pack up (one's) baggage.

DEFINITION: either a shadow cast by an object, or a faint image or copy of an object.
ORIGIN: From a compound of apo and a derivative of skia; a shading off, i.e. Obscuration.

BDAG.en: shadow (a shadow cast by variation [in position of heavenly bodies]).
BDAG.pt: sombra (uma sombra projetada por variação [na posição dos corpos celestes]).

DEFINITION: lit: to wrench away from, drag away, but perhaps sometimes in the well-attested weakened sense: to be parted or withdrawn.
ORIGIN: From apo and spao; to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously).

BDAG.en: pull/draw out, draw away from a place or point of view, draw away, attract, proselyte, tear oneself away, withdraw
BDAG.pt: arrancar, afastar de um lugar ou ponto de vista, desviar, atrair, fazer prosélito, afastar-se, retirar-se

DEFINITION: defection, apostasy, revolt.
ORIGIN: Feminine of the same as apostasion; defection from truth (properly, the state) ("apostasy").

BDAG.en: defiance of established system or authority, rebellion, abandonment, breach of faith
BDAG.pt: desafio ao sistema ou autoridade estabelecida, rebelião, abandono, quebra de fé

DEFINITION: repudiation, divorce; met: bill of divorce.
ORIGIN: Neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of aphistemi; properly, something separative, i.e. (specially) divorce.

BDAG.en: notice of divorce, certificate of divorce
BDAG.pt: notificação de divórcio, certidão de divórcio

DEFINITION: to unroof, take the roof off.
ORIGIN: From apo and a derivative of stege; to unroof.

BDAG.en: unroof, remove the roof
BDAG.pt: destelhar, remover o telhado

DEFINITION: to send forth, send (as a messenger, commission, etc.), send away, dismiss.
ORIGIN: From apo and stello; set apart, i.e. (by implication) to send out (properly, on a mission) literally or figuratively.
USAGE: put in, send (away, forth, out), set (at liberty).

BDAG.en: dispatch someone for the achievement of some objective, send away/out, dispatch a message, send, have something done
BDAG.pt: despachar alguém para a realização de algum objetivo, enviar para fora, enviar uma mensagem, mandar, fazer com que algo seja feito

DEFINITION: to defraud, deprive of, despoil; mid: to endure deprivation; pass: to be bereft of.
ORIGIN: From apo and stereo (to deprive); to despoil.
USAGE: defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud.

BDAG.en: to cause another to suffer loss by taking away through illicit means, rob, steal, despoil, defraud; to prevent someone from having the benefit of something, deprive.
BDAG.pt: causar perda a outrem tirando por meios ilícitos, roubar, furtar, espoliar, defraudar; impedir alguém de ter o benefício de algo, privar.

DEFINITION: commission, duty of apostle, apostleship.
ORIGIN: From apostello; commission, i.e. (specially) apostolate.

BDAG.en: office of a special emissary, apostleship, office of an apostle, assignment.
BDAG.pt: ofício de um emissário especial, apostolado, ofício de apóstolo, designação/missão.

DEFINITION: a messenger, envoy, delegate, one commissioned by another to represent him in some way, especially a man sent out by Jesus Christ Himself to preach the Gospel; an apostle.
ORIGIN: From apostello; a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers).
USAGE: apostle, messenger, he that is sent.

BDAG.en: delegate, envoy, messenger; messengers with extraordinary status, esp. of God’s messenger, envoy (of prophets, of Christ, and predominantly of a group of highly honored believers with a special function as God’s envoys).
BDAG.pt: delegado, enviado, mensageiro; mensageiros com status extraordinário, especialmente mensageiro de Deus, enviado (de profetas, de Cristo, e predominantemente de um grupo de crentes altamente honrados com uma função especial como enviados de Deus).

DEFINITION: to draw out by questioning.
ORIGIN: From apo and a (presumed) derivative of stoma; to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. To catechize (in an invidious manner).

BDAG.en: question closely, interrogate, quiz; perhaps have him talk (about many things).
BDAG.pt: questionar de perto, interrogar, inquinar; talvez fazê-lo falar (sobre muitas coisas).

DEFINITION: to turn away, pervert, remove; to restore, replace; mid: to desert, reject.
ORIGIN: From apo and strepho; to turn away or back (literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: to turn something away from something, turn away; to cause change in belief or behavior, turn away; to turn away from by rejecting, reject, repudiate; to return something to its customary place, return, put back; turn back.
BDAG.pt: afastar algo de algo, desviar; causar mudança na crença ou comportamento, desviar; afastar-se de alguém por rejeição, rejeitar, repudiar; devolver algo ao seu lugar habitual, retornar, repor; voltar atrás.

DEFINITION: to detest, abhor.
ORIGIN: From apo and the base of stugnetos; to detest utterly.

BDAG.en: to have a vehement dislike for something, hate strongly, abhor the evil.
BDAG.pt: ter uma aversão veemente por algo, odiar fortemente, aborrecer o mal.

DEFINITION: away from the synagogue, expelled from the synagogue, excommunicated.
ORIGIN: From apo and sunagoge; excommunicated.

BDAG.en: expelled from the synagogue, excluded, put under a curse/ban
BDAG.pt: expulso da sinagoga, excluído, posto sob maldição/banimento

DEFINITION: to withdraw from, take leave of, renounce, send away.
ORIGIN: Middle voice from apo and tasso; literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce.
USAGE: bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.

DEFINITION: to complete, accomplish, form fully, perfect, bring to maturity.
ORIGIN: From apo and teleo; to complete entirely, i.e. Consummate.

BDAG.en: to bring an activity to an end, bring to completion, finish; come to completion, be fully formed; to accomplish something, perform
BDAG.pt: trazer uma atividade a um fim, levar à conclusão, finalizar; chegar à conclusão, ser plenamente formado; realizar algo, executar

DEFINITION: to lay off or aside, renounce, stow away, put.
ORIGIN: From apo and tithemi; to put away (literally or figuratively).
USAGE: cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off).

BDAG.en: 1 take off literal clothes; fig. lay aside, rid oneself of 2 to put aside for a special purpose, lay aside (as alms) 3 to remove from a locality and place elsewhere, put away, lay down
BDAG.pt: 1 tirar roupas literais; fig. deixar de lado, livrar-se de 2 pôr de lado para um propósito especial, guardar (como esmola) 3 remover de uma localidade e colocar em outro lugar, guardar, deitar

DEFINITION: to shake off.
ORIGIN: From apo and tinasso (to jostle); to brush off.

BDAG.en: shake off something (of a snake which has bitten a hand, shake the dust from one’s feet)
BDAG.pt: sacudir algo (de uma serpente que picou uma mão, sacudir a poeira dos pés)

DEFINITION: to repay, pay what is due (by way of punishment or fine), make good.
ORIGIN: From apo and tino; to pay in full.

BDAG.en: to make compensation, pay damages
BDAG.pt: fazer compensação, pagar indenizações

DEFINITION: to assume boldness.
ORIGIN: From apo and tolmao; to venture plainly.

BDAG.en: be bold
BDAG.pt: ser ousado

DEFINITION: (lit: sheerness, of a rock), abruptness, harshness, severity, rigor.
ORIGIN: From the base of apotomos; (figuratively) decisiveness, i.e. Rigor.

BDAG.en: severity (opposite of kindness)
BDAG.pt: severidade (oposto de bondade)

DEFINITION: sharply, severely.
ORIGIN: Adverb from a derivative of a comparative of apo and temno (to cut); abruptly, i.e. Peremptorily.

BDAG.en: severely, rigorously
BDAG.pt: severamente, rigorosamente

DEFINITION: to turn away from, shun.
ORIGIN: From apo and the base of trope; to deflect, i.e. (reflexively) avoid.

BDAG.en: purposely to avoid associating w. someone, turn away from, avoid w. acc.
BDAG.pt: evitar propositalmente associar-se com alguém, afastar-se, evitar com acusativo.

DEFINITION: absence, deficiency, waste.
ORIGIN: From the participle of apeimi; a being away.

BDAG.en: absence
BDAG.pt: ausência

DEFINITION: to carry, bear away (sometimes with violence).
ORIGIN: From apo and phero; to bear off (literally or relatively).

BDAG.en: 1 to carry off from a point, carry/take away someone or someth. to a place 2 to bring from one point to another, take, bring 3 to conduct w. constraint away fr. a point, lead off, lead away 4 to deprive someone of someth., take away by force 5 to gain someth. for oneself, carry off, win mid. athletic imagery a prize
BDAG.pt: 1 transportar de um ponto, levar/retirar alguém ou algo para um lugar 2 trazer de um ponto a outro, levar, trazer 3 conduzir sob constrangimento para longe de um ponto, levar embora 4 privar alguém de algo, tirar à força 5 ganhar algo para si, levar, conquistar (meio) em imagem atlética, um prêmio

DEFINITION: to flee from, escape.
ORIGIN: From apo and pheugo; (figuratively) to escape.

BDAG.en: 1 escape, escape from w. acc. of pers. or thing fr. which one escapes 2 avoid, shun
BDAG.pt: 1 escapar, fugir de (com acusativo de pessoa ou coisa da qual se escapa) 2 evitar, esquivar-se

DEFINITION: to speak out, declare.
ORIGIN: From apo and phtheggomai; to enunciate plainly, i.e. Declare.

BDAG.en: to express oneself orally, w. focus on sound rather than content, speak out, declare boldly or loudly
BDAG.pt: expressar-se oralmente, com foco no som em vez do conteúdo, falar em voz alta, declarar com ousadia ou em voz alta

DEFINITION: to discharge a cargo.
ORIGIN: From apo and the middle voice of phortizo; to unload.

BDAG.en: unload the cargo
BDAG.pt: descarregar a carga

DEFINITION: using up, abuse, misuse.
ORIGIN: From a compound of apo and chraomai; the act of using up, i.e. Consumption.

BDAG.en: consuming, using up
BDAG.pt: consumo, utilização

DEFINITION: to go away, depart, withdraw.
ORIGIN: From apo and choreo; to go away.

BDAG.en: to move away from a point, go away; also more strongly in the sense leave, desert; or depart
BDAG.pt: mover-se de um ponto, ir embora; também mais fortemente no sentido de deixar, desertar; ou partir

DEFINITION: to separate from; mid: to part; pass: to be swept aside.
ORIGIN: From apo and chorizo; to rend apart; reflexively, to separate.

BDAG.en: separate Pass. be separated
BDAG.pt: separar. Passivo: ser separado

DEFINITION: to faint, breathe out life, die, be dismayed.
ORIGIN: From apo and psucho; to breathe out, i.e. Faint.

BDAG.en: lit. ‘breathe out, stop breathing’, hence either faint or breathe one’s last, die of or from fear
BDAG.pt: lit. 'expirar, parar de respirar', portanto desmaiar ou exalar o último suspiro, morrer de ou por medo

DEFINITION: the township Appi Forum on the Appian Way, 43 Roman miles from Rome, was named.
ORIGIN: Of Latin origin; (in the genitive, i.e. Possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman.

DEFINITION: unapproachable.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of pros and eimi (to go); inaccessible.

BDAG.en: unapproachable of God dwell in unapproachable light
BDAG.pt: inacessível, de Deus: habitar em luz inacessível

DEFINITION: (free from hurt or harm, hence) not offending, not causing offence, blameless.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of proskopto; actively, inoffensive, i.e. Not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. Not led into sin.

BDAG.en: gener. ‘without offense’; 1 pert. to being without fault because of not giving offense, undamaged, blameless; 2 pert. to not causing offense, giving no offense
BDAG.pt: em geral, ‘sem ofensa’; 1 referente a estar sem culpa por não causar ofensa, sem danos, irrepreensível; 2 referente a não causar ofensa, não ofender

DEFINITION: (literary and Jewish), without any preference (undue favor, partiality) for a person.
ORIGIN: Adverb from a compound of a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of prosopon and lambano (compare prosopoleptes); in a way not accepting the person, i.e. Impartially.

DEFINITION: without stumbling or falling, sure-footed.
ORIGIN: From a (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ptaio; not stumbling, i.e. (figuratively) without sin.

BDAG.en: without stumbling
BDAG.pt: sem tropeçar

DEFINITION: prop: to fasten to; to lay hold of, touch, know carnally.
ORIGIN: Reflexive of hapto; properly, to attach oneself to, i.e. To touch (in many implied relations).

DEFINITION: to fasten to, lay hold of.
ORIGIN: A primary verb; properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire.

BDAG.en: 1 to cause illumination or burning to take place, light, kindle; 2 to make close contact, touch, take hold of, hold; b cling to; c freq. of touching as a means of conveying a blessing, esp. to bring about a healing; 3 to partake of someth., have contact with, touch (cultic implications); 4 to touch intimately, have sexual contact, of intercourse w. a woman; 5 to make contact with a view to causing harm, touch for the purpose of harming, injure
BDAG.pt: 1 causar iluminação ou queima, acender, incendiar; 2 fazer contato próximo, tocar, agarrar, segurar; b apegar-se; c frequentemente de tocar como meio de transmitir uma bênção, especialmente para causar uma cura; 3 participar de algo, ter contato com, tocar (implicações cultuais); 4 tocar intimamente, ter contato sexual, de relação com uma mulher; 5 fazer contato com a intenção de causar dano, tocar com o propósito de ferir

DEFINITION: Apphia, a Christian lady of Colossae, either wife or sister of Philemon.
ORIGIN: Probably of foreign origin; Apphia, a woman of Collosae.

BDAG.en: Apphia, the name of a Christian, prob. wife of Philemon, at Colossae
BDAG.pt: Apfia, o nome de uma cristã, provavelmente esposa de Filemom, em Colossos

DEFINITION: to push (thrust) away, repulse, reject, refuse.
ORIGIN: Or apothomai ap-o'-thom-ahee from apo and the middle voice of otheo or otho (to shove); to push off, figuratively, to reject.
USAGE: cast away, put away (from), thrust away (from).

BDAG.en: push something 'away' or 'aside.' 1 push aside lit. 2 reject, repudiate, fig. ext. of 1
BDAG.pt: empurrar algo 'para longe' ou 'para o lado.' 1 empurrar para o lado literalmente. 2 rejeitar, repudiar, extensão figurada de 1

DEFINITION: destruction, ruin, loss, perishing; eternal ruin.
ORIGIN: From a presumed derivative of apollumi; ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal).
USAGE: damnable(-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste.

BDAG.en: 1 the destruction that one causes, destruction, waste trans.; 2 the destruction that one experiences, annihilation both complete and in process, ruin intr.; Esp. of eternal destruction as punishment for the wicked
BDAG.pt: 1 a destruição que alguém causa, destruição, desperdício transitivo; 2 a destruição que alguém experimenta, aniquilação tanto completa quanto em processo, ruína intransitiva; Especialmente de destruição eterna como punição para os ímpios

DEFINITION: a prayer; more commonly: a prayer for evil, a curse, imprecation.
ORIGIN: Probably from airo; properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation.

BDAG.en: curse
BDAG.pt: maldição

DEFINITION: therefore (an illative particle).
ORIGIN: Probably from airo (through the idea of drawing a conclusion); a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows).
USAGE: haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore. Often used in connection with other particles, especially ge or oun (after) or ei (before). Compare also ara.

BDAG.en: transitional/inferential (illative) particle; 1 marker of an inference made on the basis of what precedes (so, then, consequently); b freq. in questions which draw an inference fr. what precedes; 2 to express result (then, as a result); 3 to express someth. tentative, perhaps, conceivably
