DEFINITION: hair (of the head or of animals).
ORIGIN: Genitive case trichos, etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair.

BDAG.en: hair (of animals or human)
BDAG.pt: cabelo, pelo (de animais ou humano)

DEFINITION: to disturb, agitate; pass: to be troubled, alarmed.
ORIGIN: From threomai to wail; to clamor, i.e. (by implication) to frighten.

BDAG.en: be inwardly aroused, be disturbed or frightened (passive only in NT)
BDAG.pt: ser interiormente agitado, ficar perturbado ou amedrontado (somente no passivo no NT)

DEFINITION: a clot, large drop (of blood).
ORIGIN: Perhaps from trepho (in the sense of thickening); a clot.

BDAG.en: drop (of blood), clot of blood
BDAG.pt: gota (de sangue), coágulo de sangue

DEFINITION: a (king's) throne, seat; meton: power, dominion; a potentate.
ORIGIN: From thrao (to sit); a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate.

BDAG.en: chair, seat; a seat for one of high status, throne; supreme power, dominion; class of powerful beings
BDAG.pt: cadeira, assento; assento para alguém de alta patente, trono; poder supremo, domínio; classe de seres poderosos

DEFINITION: Thyatira, a city of the old district Lydia, in the Roman province Asia.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor.

BDAG.en: Thyatira (a city in Lydia in Asia Minor)
BDAG.pt: Tiatira (uma cidade na Lídia, na Ásia Menor)

DEFINITION: a daughter; hence (Hebraistic?), of any female descendent, however far removed; even of one unrelated: young lady.
ORIGIN: Apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant).

BDAG.en: female in relation of child to parent, daughter; someone treated as one’s daughter; female members of an ancestral group; personified as female, daughter
BDAG.pt: fêmea na relação de filho para pai/mãe, filha; alguém tratado como filha; membros femininos de um grupo ancestral; personificada como feminina, filha

DEFINITION: a little (young) daughter.
ORIGIN: From thugater; a daughterling.

BDAG.en: diminutive of θυγάτηρ: little daughter (can denote one marriageable); term of endearment.
BDAG.pt: Diminutivo de θυγάτηρ: filhinha (pode denotar uma moça em idade de casar); termo de carinho.

DEFINITION: a storm, tempest, whirlwind.
ORIGIN: From thuo (in the sense of blowing) a storm.

BDAG.en: Atmospheric disturbance marked by violent gusts of wind: storm, whirlwind.
BDAG.pt: Perturbação atmosférica marcada por rajadas de vento violentas: tempestade, turbilhão.

DEFINITION: of the sandarach (so-called citron) tree.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of thuo (in the sense of blowing; denoting a certain fragrant tree); made of citron-wood.

BDAG.en: From the citron tree: citron wood = scented.
BDAG.pt: Da árvore de cidra: madeira de cidra = perfumado.

DEFINITION: incense.
ORIGIN: From thumiao; an aroma, i.e. Fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself.

BDAG.en: 1. Aromatic substance used in cultic ritual: incense. 2. Cultic burning of incense: incense burning, incense offering.
BDAG.pt: 1. Substância aromática usada no ritual cultual: incenso. 2. Queima cultual de incenso: queima de incenso, oferta de incenso.

DEFINITION: (ordinarily: censer, but) either the altar of incense, or the shovel, on which the high-priest poured the coals, when he entered the Holy of Holies on the Day of Atonement.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of thumiao; a place of fumigation, i.e. The alter of incense (in the Temple).

BDAG.en: Generically a place or vessel for the burning of incense, usually a 'censer', but can mean 'incense altar'.
BDAG.pt: Genericamente um lugar ou vaso para a queima de incenso, geralmente um 'turíbulo', mas pode significar 'altar de incenso'.

DEFINITION: to burn incense.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of thuo (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e. Offer aromatic fumes.

BDAG.en: To make an incense offering.
BDAG.pt: Fazer uma oferta de incenso.

DEFINITION: (lit: to fight desperately, hence) to be furiously angry with.
ORIGIN: From a presumed compound of thumos and machomai; to be in a furious fight, i.e. (figuratively) to be exasperated.

BDAG.en: be very angry at someone
BDAG.pt: ficar muito zangado com alguém

DEFINITION: an outburst of passion, wrath.
ORIGIN: From thuo; passion (as if breathing hard).

BDAG.en: 1. Intense expression of the inner self, strong desire, passion. 2. A state of intense displeasure, anger, wrath, rage, indignation.
BDAG.pt: 1. Expressão intensa do eu interior, forte desejo, paixão. 2. Um estado de intensa desaprovação, raiva, cólera, fúria, indignação.

DEFINITION: to provoke to anger; pass: to be wroth or very angry.
ORIGIN: From thumos; to put in a passion, i.e. Enrage.

BDAG.en: To make angry; (Passive) to become angry.
BDAG.pt: Enfurecer; (Passivo) ficar irado.

DEFINITION: (a) a door, (b) met: an opportunity.
ORIGIN: Apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: Door; figuratively, an opening made possible/feasible, or the door to the kingdom of heaven. Jesus calls himself the door (the gate for the sheep).
BDAG.pt: Porta; figurativamente, uma abertura que torna algo possível/viável, ou a porta para o reino dos céus. Jesus se chama a porta (o portão para as ovelhas).

DEFINITION: the heavy oblong Roman shield.
ORIGIN: From thura; a large shield (as door-shaped).

BDAG.en: Prop. 'a long, oblong shield' (shaped like a door): shield, in imagery shield of faith.
BDAG.pt: Propriamente 'um escudo longo e oblongo' (em forma de porta): escudo, na imagética, escudo da fé.

DEFINITION: a small opening, window.
ORIGIN: From thura; an aperture, i.e. Window.

BDAG.en: Window.
BDAG.pt: Janela.

DEFINITION: a door-keeper, porter.
ORIGIN: From thura and ouros (a watcher); a gate- warden.

BDAG.en: Doorkeeper, gatekeeper.
BDAG.pt: Porteiro, guarda do portão.

DEFINITION: abstr. and concr: sacrifice; a sacrifice, offering.
ORIGIN: From thuo; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: The act of offering, offering; that which is offered as a sacrifice, sacrifice, offering (literal, sacrificial death of Christ, or figurative, e.g., spiritual sacrifice, praise-offering, living sacrifice).
BDAG.pt: O ato de oferecer, oferta; aquilo que é oferecido como sacrifício, sacrifício, oferta (literal, morte sacrificial de Cristo, ou figurativo, ex.: sacrifício espiritual, oferta de louvor, sacrifício vivo).

DEFINITION: an altar (for sacrifice).
ORIGIN: From a derivative of thusia; a place of sacrifice, i.e. An altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative).

BDAG.en: A structure on which cultic observances are carried out, including esp. sacrifices, altar (altar of burnt offering, incense altar, heavenly altar, or an altar in general).
BDAG.pt: Uma estrutura na qual observâncias cultuais são realizadas, incluindo especialmente sacrifícios, altar (altar de holocausto, altar de incenso, altar celestial, ou um altar em geral).

DEFINITION: to sacrifice, generally an animal; hence: to kill.
ORIGIN: A primary verb; properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e. (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose).

BDAG.en: to make a cultic offering, sacrifice; to take life, kill, slaughter; to kill ceremonially, slaughter sacrificially; to celebrate (often when an animal is slaughtered in connection with a celebration).
BDAG.pt: fazer uma oferenda cultual, sacrificar; tirar a vida, matar, abater; matar cerimonialmente, abater sacrificialmente; celebrar (frequentemente quando um animal é abatido em conexão com uma celebração).

DEFINITION: "the twin", Thomas, one of the twelve apostles.
ORIGIN: Of Chaldee origin (compare ta'owm); the twin; Thomas, a Christian.

DEFINITION: a breast-plate, corslet, cuirass.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet.

BDAG.en: protective covering for the chest in combat, breastplate; the part of the body covered by the breastplate, the chest.
BDAG.pt: cobertura protetora para o peito em combate, couraça/peitoral; a parte do corpo coberta pela couraça, o peito.

DEFINITION: Jairus, the ruler of a synagogue in Palestine.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Ya'iyr); Jairus (i.e. Jair), an Israelite.

DEFINITION: (Hebrew), Jacob, (a) the patriarch, son of Isaac, (b) father of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Ya'aqob); Jacob (i.e. Ja'akob), the progenitor of the Israelites.

BDAG.en: Jacob (1. son of Isaac, patriarch; 2. the nation of Israel, descendants of Jacob; 3. father of Joseph, in Jesus' genealogy)
BDAG.pt: Jacó (1. filho de Isaque, patriarca; 2. a nação de Israel, descendentes de Jacó; 3. pai de José, na genealogia de Jesus)

DEFINITION: James, (a) the Small, son of Alphaeus, and one of the Twelve, (b) half-brother of Jesus, (c) father (?) of Jude, (d) son of Zebedee, and brother of John, one of the Twelve, killed A.D. 44.
ORIGIN: The same as Iakob Graecized; Jacobus, the name of three Israelites.

BDAG.en: James (1. son of Zebedee, brother of John; 2. son of Alphaeus, apostle; 3. son of Mary; 4. the Lord’s brother, head of the Jerusalem community; 5. father of a Judas; 6. the tax-collector)
BDAG.pt: Tiago (1. filho de Zebedeu, irmão de João; 2. filho de Alfeu, apóstolo; 3. filho de Maria; 4. irmão do Senhor, chefe da comunidade de Jerusalém; 5. pai de um Judas; 6. o coletor de impostos)

DEFINITION: healing, curing, remedy.
ORIGIN: From iaomai; a cure (the effect).

BDAG.en: healing (used in the phrase 'spiritual gifts of healing').
BDAG.pt: cura (usado na expressão 'dons espirituais de curas').

DEFINITION: Jambres, a sorcerer at the court of the Pharaoh.
ORIGIN: Of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian.

BDAG.en: Jambres (one of the Egyptian sorcerers who opposed Moses)
BDAG.pt: Jambres (um dos feiticeiros egípcios que se opuseram a Moisés)

DEFINITION: Jannai, an ancestor of Jesus; Jannai was the son of Joseph, and father of Melchi.
ORIGIN: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare yanah); Janna, an Israelite.

DEFINITION: Jannes, a sorcerer at the court of the Pharaoh.
ORIGIN: Of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian.

BDAG.en: Jannes (named with Jambres as one of the Egyptian sorcerers who opposed Moses)
BDAG.pt: Janes (nomeado com Jambres como um dos feiticeiros egípcios que se opuseram a Moisés)

DEFINITION: to heal, generally of the physical, sometimes of spiritual, disease.
ORIGIN: Middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to cure (literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: to restore to health, heal, cure (physically); to deliver from ills/conditions, restore, heal (figuratively, esp. sin)
BDAG.pt: restaurar à saúde, sarar, curar (fisicamente); livrar de males/condições, restaurar, curar (figurativamente, especialmente o pecado)

DEFINITION: (Hebrew), Jared, son of Mahalalel and father of Enoch.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yered); Jared (i.e. Jered), an antediluvian.

DEFINITION: a cure, healing.
ORIGIN: From iaomai; curing (the act).

BDAG.en: Restoration to health after a physical malady, healing, cure (lit.); deliverance from ills beyond physical maladies, cure, deliverance (fig. extension of meaning 1), e.g., forgiveness of sins.
BDAG.pt: Restauração da saúde após uma doença física, cura (sentido literal); livramento de males além das doenças físicas, cura, livramento (extensão figurada do sentido 1), ex: perdão dos pecados.

DEFINITION: jasper (a translucent stone).
ORIGIN: Probably of foreign origin (see yashpheh); "jasper", a gem.

BDAG.en: Jasper, a precious stone found in various colors. In antiquity, the name could designate any opaque precious stone.
BDAG.pt: Jaspe, uma pedra preciosa encontrada em várias cores. Na antiguidade, o nome podia designar qualquer pedra preciosa opaca.

DEFINITION: Jason, a Christian of Thessalonica, perhaps the same as the relative of Paul.
ORIGIN: Future active participle masculine of iaomai; about to cure; Jason, a Christian.

BDAG.en: Jason (1. host of Paul and Silas in Thessalonica; 2. one who sends a greeting; 3. variant reading)
BDAG.pt: Jasão (1. anfitrião de Paulo e Silas em Tessalônica; 2. um que envia saudações; 3. leitura variante)

DEFINITION: a physician.
ORIGIN: From iaomai; a physician.

BDAG.en: One who undertakes the cure of physical ailments, physician; one who undertakes the healing of supra-physical maladies, physician (of the soul) (e.g., of God or Christ).
BDAG.pt: Aquele que se ocupa da cura de enfermidades físicas, médico; aquele que se ocupa da cura de males supra-físicos, médico (da alma) (ex: de Deus ou de Cristo).

DEFINITION: See! Lo! Behold! Look!.
ORIGIN: Second person singular imperative active of eido; used as an interjection to denote surprise; lo!.

BDAG.en: Properly imperative of εἶδον (to see), but used as a particle: look! see! (to draw attention); take notice (to introduce something unexpected); here is/are (to indicate a place or individual); see! pay attention! (with loss of fundamental meaning).
BDAG.pt: Impersonal do verbo εἶδον (ver), mas usado como partícula: olhe! veja! (para chamar a atenção); preste atenção (para introduzir algo inesperado); eis aqui (para indicar um lugar ou indivíduo); veja! preste atenção! (com perda do sentido fundamental).

DEFINITION: form, outward appearance.
ORIGIN: From eido; a sight (comparative figuratively "idea"), i.e. Aspect.

BDAG.en: Outward look of something, appearance (focusing on physical features); a variety of something, form, kind.
BDAG.pt: A aparência exterior de algo, aspecto (com foco nas características físicas); uma variedade de algo, forma, espécie.

DEFINITION: one's own, belonging to one, private, personal; one's own people, one's own family, home, property.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain affinity; pertaining to self, i.e. One's own; by implication, private or separate.
USAGE: X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private(-ly), proper, severally, their (own).

BDAG.en: pert. to belonging or being related to oneself, one’s own; pert. to a striking connection or an exclusive relationship, own; pert. to a person, through substitution for a pronoun, own; as subst., person or thing associated with an entity; pert. to being distinctively characteristic of some entity, belonging to/peculiar to an individual.
BDAG.pt: pertencente ou relacionado a si mesmo, próprio; referente a uma conexão marcante ou relacionamento exclusivo, próprio; referente a uma pessoa, por substituição de um pronome, próprio; como substantivo, pessoa ou coisa associada a uma entidade; referente a ser distintamente característico de alguma entidade, pertencente ou peculiar a um indivíduo.

DEFINITION: (unofficial, hence) an amateur, an unprofessional man, a layman; an ungifted person.
ORIGIN: From idios; a private person, i.e. (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot").

BDAG.en: a person who is relatively unskilled or inexperienced in some activity or field of knowledge, layperson, amateur in contrast to an expert or specialist of any kind; one who is not knowledgeable about some particular group’s experience, one not in the know, outsider.
BDAG.pt: uma pessoa relativamente inexperiente ou não qualificada em alguma atividade ou campo de conhecimento, leigo, amador em contraste com um especialista ou perito de qualquer tipo; aquele que não tem conhecimento da experiência de algum grupo em particular, um não iniciado, um estranho.

DEFINITION: See! Lo! Behold! Look!.
ORIGIN: Second person singular imperative middle voice of eido; used as imperative lo!.

BDAG.en: demonstrative or presentative particle that draws attention to what follows: ‘(you) see, look, behold’; prompter of attention; marker of strong emphasis.
BDAG.pt: partícula demonstrativa ou presentativa que atrai a atenção para o que se segue: ‘(você) veja, olhe, eis’; chamador de atenção; marcador de forte ênfase.

DEFINITION: Idumea, Edom, a district of Arabia, immediately south of Judea.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin ('Edom); Idumaea (i.e. Edom), a region East (and South) of Palestine.

BDAG.en: Idumea, Grecized form of Edom; a mountainous district south of Judea
BDAG.pt: Idumeia, forma grega de Edom; um distrito montanhoso ao sul da Judeia.

DEFINITION: sweat, perspiration.
ORIGIN: A strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat): perspiration.

BDAG.en: sweat, perspiration
BDAG.pt: suor, transpiração.

DEFINITION: Jezebel, name given to a false prophetess of Thyatira, possibly borrowed from the name of Ahab's wife, queen of Israel.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin ('Iyzebel); Jezabel (i.e. Jezebel), a Tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher).

BDAG.en: Jezebel, Ahab’s queen, who favored the cult of the Phoenician Baal in Israel and persecuted the prophets of Yahweh; hence the name was applied to a woman who endangered orthodox teaching within the Christian community
BDAG.pt: Jezabel, rainha de Acabe, que favoreceu o culto do Baal fenícia em Israel e perseguiu os profetas de Yahweh; daí o nome foi aplicado a uma mulher que colocou em perigo o ensino ortodoxo dentro da comunidade cristã.

DEFINITION: Hierapolis, a city of the Lycus valley in Phrygia, near Laodicea and Colossae.
ORIGIN: From hieros and polis; holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor.

BDAG.en: Hierapolis, a city in Phrygia in Asia Minor, on the Lycus R.
BDAG.pt: Hierápolis, uma cidade na Frígia, na Ásia Menor, no rio Lico.

DEFINITION: the duty (office) of a priest, priesthood.
ORIGIN: From hierateuo; priestliness, i.e. The sacerdotal function.
USAGE: office of the priesthood, priest's office.

BDAG.en: priestly office/service; Priesthood
BDAG.pt: ofício/serviço sacerdotal; Sacerdócio

DEFINITION: the act or office of priesthood.
ORIGIN: From hierateuo; the priestly fraternity, i.e. Sacerdotal order (figuratively).

BDAG.en: priesthood (of royal rank or in royal service)
BDAG.pt: sacerdócio (de posto real ou em serviço real)

DEFINITION: to serve as priest.
ORIGIN: Prolongation from hiereus; to be a priest, i.e. Perform his functions.

BDAG.en: hold the office or perform the service of a priest
BDAG.pt: exercer o ofício ou realizar o serviço de um sacerdote.

DEFINITION: Jeremiah, an O.T. prophet.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yirmyah); Hieremias (i.e. Jermijah), an Israelite.

BDAG.en: Jeremiah, OT prophet at the time of the fall of the Judean state
BDAG.pt: Jeremias, profeta do Antigo Testamento na época da queda do estado judaico.

DEFINITION: a priest, one who offers sacrifice to a god (in Jewish and pagan religions; of Christians only met.).
ORIGIN: From hieros; a priest (literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: priest; of Israel’s priests; of the high priest; fig. of Christ; of the Christians
BDAG.pt: sacerdote; dos sacerdotes de Israel; do sumo sacerdote; fig. de Cristo; dos cristãos.

DEFINITION: Jericho, a city a little north of the Dead Sea.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yriychow); Jericho, a place in Palestine.

BDAG.en: Jericho, a city in Judea, not far from the ford across the Jordan just north of the Dead Sea
BDAG.pt: Jericó, uma cidade na Judeia, não longe da travessia do Jordão, logo ao norte do Mar Morto.

DEFINITION: a temple, either the whole building, or specifically the outer courts, open to worshippers.
ORIGIN: Neuter of hieros; a sacred place, i.e. The entire precincts (whereas naos denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem or elsewhere).

BDAG.en: sanctuary, temple (of Gr-Rom. temples or of the temple at Jerusalem, including the whole temple precinct)
BDAG.pt: santuário, templo (de templos greco-romanos ou do templo em Jerusalém, incluindo todo o recinto do templo).

DEFINITION: suitable to a sacred character, reverent.
ORIGIN: From hieros and the same as prepo; reverent.

BDAG.en: reverent, venerable
BDAG.pt: reverente, venerável.

DEFINITION: sacred, a sacred thing, a temple.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain affinity; sacred.

BDAG.en: pert. to being of transcendent purity, holy; belonging to the temple and its service, holy thing
BDAG.pt: pertencente a ser de pureza transcendente, santo; pertencente ao templo e ao seu serviço, coisa sagrada

DEFINITION: Jerusalem, the capital of united Israel and Judah.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yruwshalaim); Hierosolyma (i.e. Jerushalaim}, the capitol of Palestine.

BDAG.en: Jerusalem
BDAG.pt: Jerusalém.

DEFINITION: an inhabitant of Jerusalem.
ORIGIN: From Hierosoluma; a Hierosolymite, i.e. Inhabitant of Hierosolyma.

BDAG.en: an inhabitant of Jerusalem
BDAG.pt: um habitante de Jerusalém

DEFINITION: to commit sacrilege, rob a temple.
ORIGIN: From hierosulos; to be a temple-robber (figuratively).

BDAG.en: to take objects from a temple by force or stealth, rob temples; to commit irreverent acts, commit sacrilege
BDAG.pt: tirar objetos de um templo à força ou furtivamente, saquear templos; cometer atos irreverentes, cometer sacrilégio

DEFINITION: robbing temples, but possibly simply: sacrilegious.
ORIGIN: From hieron and sulao; a temple-despoiler.

BDAG.en: pert. to a temple robber, subst. temple robber; transf. sense of sacrilegious, subst. a sacrilegious person, i.e. the equivalent of a temple plunderer
BDAG.pt: pertencente a um ladrão de templo, substantivo ladrão de templo; sentido transferido de sacrílego, substantivo uma pessoa sacrílega, ou seja, o equivalente a um saqueador de templo

DEFINITION: to minister in holy things.
ORIGIN: From a compound of hieron and the base of ergon; to be a temple-worker, i.e. Officiate as a priest (figuratively).

BDAG.en: to act in some cultic or sacred capacity, perform holy service, act as a priest
BDAG.pt: agir em alguma capacidade cultual ou sagrada, realizar serviço sagrado, agir como sacerdote

DEFINITION: (Aramaic form), Jerusalem, the capital of Palestine: hence Judaism, and allegorically, Christendom, the Christian Church.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yruwshalaim); Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine.

DEFINITION: the abstract notion of the priestly office.
ORIGIN: From hieros; sacredness, i.e. (by implication) the priestly office.

BDAG.en: priestly office, priesthood
BDAG.pt: ofício sacerdotal, sacerdócio

DEFINITION: (Hebrew), Jesse, son of Obed, and father of King David.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yishay); Jessae (i.e. Jishai), an Israelite.

BDAG.en: Jesse, David’s father
BDAG.pt: Jessé, pai de Davi

DEFINITION: (Hebrew), Jephthah, one of the Judges of Israel.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yiphtach); Jephthae (i.e. Jiphtach), an Israelite.

BDAG.en: Jephthah, son of Gilead, one of the judges of Israel
BDAG.pt: Jefte, filho de Gileade, um dos juízes de Israel

DEFINITION: (Hebrew), Jechoniah, son of Josiah and father of Salathiel.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Ykonyah); Jechonias (i.e. Jekonjah), an Israelite.

BDAG.en: Jechoniah, a king of Judah
BDAG.pt: Jeconias, um rei de Judá

DEFINITION: Jesus; the Greek form of Joshua; Jesus, son of Eliezer; Jesus, surnamed Justus.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yhowshuwa'); Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites.

BDAG.en: Joshua/Jesus. (1) Joshua, successor of Moses, military leader of the people when they entered Canaan. (2) Jesus, son of Eliezer, in the genealogy of Jesus. (3) Jesus Christ, more definitely designated as Ἰ. Χριστός, Χριστὸς Ἰ., ὁ κύριος Ἰ. (Christ). (4) Jesus Barabbas. (5) Jesus/Justus (Ἰ. ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος), co-worker, in Col 4:11.
BDAG.pt: Josué/Jesus. (1) Josué, sucessor de Moisés, líder militar do povo ao entrar em Canaã. (2) Jesus, filho de Eliezer, na genealogia de Jesus. (3) Jesus Cristo, designado mais especificamente como Ἰ. Χριστός, Χριστὸς Ἰ., ὁ κύριος Ἰ. (Cristo). (4) Jesus Barrabás. (5) Jesus/Justo (Ἰ. ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος), colaborador, em Colossenses 4:11.

DEFINITION: (a) considerable, sufficient, of number, quantity, time, (b) of persons: sufficiently strong (good, etc.), worthy, suitable, with various constructions, (c) many, much.
ORIGIN: From hiko (hikano or hikneomai, akin to heko) (to arrive); competent (as if coming in season), i.e. Ample (in amount) or fit (in character).
USAGE: able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long (while), many, meet, much, security, sore, sufficient, worthy.

BDAG.en: sufficient in degree, sufficient, adequate, large enough; pert. to meeting a standard, fit, appropriate, competent, qualified, able, worthy, good enough; pert. to being large in extent or degree, considerable (of persons, things, or time); in relatively large numbers, many, quite a few.
BDAG.pt: suficiente em grau, suficiente, adequado, grande o suficiente; pertencente a cumprir um padrão, apto, apropriado, competente, qualificado, capaz, digno, bom o suficiente; pertencente a ser grande em extensão ou grau, considerável (de pessoas, coisas ou tempo); em números relativamente grandes, muitos, bastantes.

DEFINITION: sufficiency, ability, power, fitness.
ORIGIN: From hikanos; ability.

BDAG.en: state of being qualified or adequate for someth., fitness, capability, qualification
BDAG.pt: estado de ser qualificado ou adequado para algo, aptidão, capacidade, qualificação

DEFINITION: to make sufficient, render fit, qualify.
ORIGIN: From hikanos; to enable, i.e. Qualify.

BDAG.en: to cause to be adequate, make sufficient, qualify (perhaps shading into the sense empower, authorize)
BDAG.pt: fazer ser adequado, tornar suficiente, qualificar (talvez inclinando-se para o sentido de empoderar, autorizar)

DEFINITION: (originally: the olive branch held in the hand of the suppliant), supplication, entreaty.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of the base of hikanos (through the idea of approaching for a favor); intreaty.

BDAG.en: supplication (as a sign of a suppliant, or the act itself), prayer (as a supplication made to God)
BDAG.pt: súplica (como sinal de um suplicante, ou o ato em si), oração (como súplica feita a Deus)

DEFINITION: moisture.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain affinity; dampness.

BDAG.en: moisture: of moisture in the soil, without which plants cannot live; of juices secreted by decaying flesh.
BDAG.pt: umidade: de umidade no solo, sem a qual as plantas não podem viver; de sucos secretados por carne em decomposição.

DEFINITION: Iconium, a Phrygian city of the Roman province Galatia (modern Konia).
ORIGIN: Perhaps from eikon; image-like; Iconium, a place in Asia Minor.

BDAG.en: Iconium (a city visited by Paul)
BDAG.pt: Icônio (uma cidade visitada por Paulo)

DEFINITION: joyous, cheerful, not grudging.
ORIGIN: From the same as hileos; propitious or merry ("hilarious"), i.e. Prompt or willing.

BDAG.en: pert. to being full of cheer, cheerful, glad, happy (of things, animals, or humans); one who gives cheerfully, gladly (without reluctance).
BDAG.pt: pertencente a ser cheio de alegria, alegre, contente, feliz (de coisas, animais ou humanos); aquele que dá alegremente, de bom grado (sem relutância).

DEFINITION: cheerfulness, graciousness.
ORIGIN: From hilaros; alacrity.

BDAG.en: quality or state of cheerfulness, cheerfulness, gladness, wholeheartedness, graciousness
BDAG.pt: qualidade ou estado de alegria, vivacidade, contentamento, sinceridade, benevolência

DEFINITION: (a) to have mercy on, show favor to, (b) trans. with object of sins: to forgive, pardon.
ORIGIN: Middle voice from the same as hileos; to conciliate, i.e. (transitively) to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious.

BDAG.en: 1 to cause to be favorably inclined or disposed, propitiate, conciliate; 2 to eliminate impediments that alienate the deity, expiate, wipe out (of Christ as high priest)
BDAG.pt: 1 fazer com que fique favoravelmente inclinado ou disposto, propiciar, conciliar; 2 eliminar impedimentos que afastam a divindade, expiar, anular (de Cristo como sumo sacerdote)

DEFINITION: a propitiation (of an angry god), atoning sacrifice.
ORIGIN: Atonement, i.e. (concretely) an expiator.

BDAG.en: appeasement necessitated by sin, expiation; instrument for appeasing, sacrifice to atone, sin-offering
BDAG.pt: apaziguamento necessário devido ao pecado, expiação; instrumento para apaziguar, sacrifício para expiar, oferta de expiação/pecado

DEFINITION: (a) a sin offering, by which the wrath of the deity shall be appeased; a means of propitiation, (b) the covering of the ark, which was sprinkled with the atoning blood on the Day of Atonement.
ORIGIN: Neuter of a derivative of hilaskomai; an expiatory (place or thing), i.e. (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple).

BDAG.en: that which serves as an instrument for regaining the goodwill of a deity; means of expiation, of Christ; place of propitiation (LXX, mercy-seat)
BDAG.pt: aquilo que serve como instrumento para recuperar a boa vontade de uma divindade; meio de expiação, de Cristo; lugar de propiciação (LXX, propiciatório)

DEFINITION: propitious, forgiving, merciful.
ORIGIN: Perhaps from the alternate form of haireomai; cheerful (as attractive), i.e. Propitious; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be gracious!, i.e. (in averting some calamity) far be it.

BDAG.en: pert. to being favorably disposed, gracious, merciful (mostly of God); may God be gracious to you, God forbid!
BDAG.pt: pertencente a estar favoravelmente disposto, gracioso, misericordioso (principalmente de Deus); que Deus seja gracioso para contigo, Deus me livre!

DEFINITION: Illyricum, a Roman province, afterwards called Dalmatia, bounded by Pannonia on the north, Macedonia on the south, Moesia on the east, and the Adriatic Sea on the west.
ORIGIN: Neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation: (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe.

BDAG.en: Illyricum, a district across the Adriatic Sea from Italy
BDAG.pt: Ilírico, um distrito do outro lado do Mar Adriático em relação à Itália

DEFINITION: a thong, strap, (a) for binding a man who is to be flogged, (b) for fastening a sandal or shoe.
ORIGIN: Perhaps from the same as hama; a strap, i.e. (specially) the tie (of a sandal) or the lash (of a scourge).

BDAG.en: leather strap or thong, on sandals
BDAG.pt: tira ou correia de couro, em sandálias

DEFINITION: to clothe, provide clothing for; pass: to be clothed.
ORIGIN: From himation; to dress.

BDAG.en: dress, clothe
BDAG.pt: vestir, prover de roupa

DEFINITION: a long flowing outer garment, tunic.
ORIGIN: Neuter of a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on); a dress (inner or outer).
USAGE: apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture.

BDAG.en: outer clothing, cloak, robe; (plural) clothes; clothing fit for mourners; (verbally) to wear out
BDAG.pt: veste exterior, manto, túnica; (plural) roupas; vestimenta própria para enlutados; (verbalmente) desgastar

DEFINITION: a collective word: raiment, clothing.
ORIGIN: From himatizo; clothing.

BDAG.en: clothing, apparel
BDAG.pt: vestimenta, traje

DEFINITION: to desire earnestly, long for; to have a strong affection for, love fervently.
ORIGIN: Middle voice from himeros (a yearning; of uncertain affinity); to long for.

BDAG.en: to have a strong yearning, long for someone
BDAG.pt: ter um forte anseio, desejar ardentemente alguém.

DEFINITION: in order that, that, so that.
ORIGIN: Probably from the same as the former part of heautou (through the demonstrative idea; compare ho); in order that (denoting the purpose or the result).
USAGE: albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to. Compare hina me.

BDAG.en: marker to denote purpose, aim, or goal (in order that, that); marker of objective (that); marker serving as substitute for the inf. of result (so that); marker of retroactive emphasis (that)
BDAG.pt: conjunção final, indicando propósito, objetivo (a fim de que, para que); marcador de objetivo (que); marcador substituto do infinitivo de resultado (de modo que); marcador de ênfase retroativa (que)

DEFINITION: for what purpose?.
ORIGIN: From hina and tis; for what reason ?, i.e. Why?.

BDAG.en: why, for what reason?
BDAG.pt: por que, por qual razão?

DEFINITION: Joppa, a coast town of Judea, west-north-west of Jerusalem.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yapho); Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in Palestine.

BDAG.en: Joppa, modern Jaffa, seaport and city on the Philistine coast northwest of Jerusalem
BDAG.pt: Jope (Jaffa), cidade portuária na costa filisteia a noroeste de Jerusalém

DEFINITION: the Jordan, a great river flowing due south and bounding Galilee, Samaria, and Judea on the east.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yarden); the Jordanes (i.e. Jarden), a river of Palestine.

BDAG.en: the Jordan, chief river of Palestine. It arises at the foot of Mt. Hermon, flows through the Sea of Galilee, and empties into the Dead Sea
BDAG.pt: o Jordão, principal rio da Palestina. Nasce ao pé do Monte Hermom, flui através do Mar da Galileia e deságua no Mar Morto

DEFINITION: poison, rust; an arrow.
ORIGIN: Perhaps from eimi (to go) or hiemi (to send); rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents).

BDAG.en: 1 poison, venom a lit. b fig. 2 corrosion, rust
BDAG.pt: 1 veneno, peçonha a) literal b) figurado 2 corrosão, ferrugem

DEFINITION: Judah, Judas, Jude.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yhuwdah or perhaps Yuttah); Judah (i.e. Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine.

DEFINITION: Judea, a Roman province, capital Jerusalem.
ORIGIN: Feminine of Ioudaios (with ge implied); the Judaean land (i.e. Judaea), a region of Palestine.

BDAG.en: 1 the southern part of Palestine in contrast to Samaria, Galilee, Perea and Idumea, Judea. 2 Judea, broadly understood as the region occupied by the people of Israel, Judea =‘land of the Judeans (Jews)’, i.e. Palestine
BDAG.pt: 1 a parte sul da Palestina em contraste com a Samaria, Galileia, Pereia e Idumeia, Judeia. 2 Judeia, entendida amplamente como a região ocupada pelo povo de Israel, Judeia = 'terra dos judeus', ou seja, Palestina

DEFINITION: to live as a Jew (in religion, ceremonially).
ORIGIN: From Ioudaios; to become a Judaean, i.e. "Judaize".

BDAG.en: live as one bound by Mosaic ordinances or traditions, live in Judean or Jewish fashion
BDAG.pt: viver como alguém obrigado pelas ordenanças ou tradições mosaicas, viver à maneira judaica ou da Judeia

DEFINITION: Jewish, Judaic.
ORIGIN: From Ioudaios; Judaic, i.e. Resembling a Judaean.

BDAG.en: Judean (Jewish)
BDAG.pt: Judaico (Judeu)

DEFINITION: in the manner of Jews (religiously, ceremonially).
ORIGIN: Adverb from Ioudaikos; Judaically or in a manner resembling a Judaean.

BDAG.en: in a Judean (Jewish) manner
BDAG.pt: à maneira judaica (judaíta)

DEFINITION: Jewish, a Jew, Judea.
ORIGIN: From Iouda (in the sense of Ioudas as a country); Judaean, i.e. Belonging to Jehudah.

BDAG.en: Gener. as description of ‘one who identifies with beliefs, rites, and customs of adherents of Israel’s Mosaic and prophetic tradition’ (the standard term in the Mishnah is ‘Israelite’). 1 pert. to being Judean (Jewish), with focus on adherence to Mosaic tradition, Judean, as a real adj. 2 one who is Judean (Jewish), with focus on adherence to Mosaic tradition, a Judean, Ἰουδαῖος as noun (so predom.)
BDAG.pt: Em geral, como descrição de 'aquele que se identifica com as crenças, ritos e costumes dos aderentes à tradição mosaica e profética de Israel' (o termo padrão na Mishná é 'israelita'). 1 Pertencente a ser judeu (judaíta), com foco na adesão à tradição mosaica, judaíta, como adjetivo real. 2 Aquele que é judeu (judaíta), com foco na adesão à tradição mosaica, um judeu, Ἰουδαῖος como substantivo (predominante)

DEFINITION: the Jewish religion, Judaism.
ORIGIN: From Ioudaizo; "Judaism", i.e. The Jewish faith and usages.

BDAG.en: Judeanism/Judaism=the Judean way of belief and life
BDAG.pt: Judaísmo, ou seja, o modo de crença e vida judaico

DEFINITION: Judah, Judas, the name of several Israelites, also one of the twelve tribes of Isr., also the Southern kingdom.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yhuwdah); Judas (i.e. Jehudah), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region.

BDAG.en: Judas/Judah. Used for the patriarch Jacob's son, the tribe of Judah, the country of Judah, and for several individuals: Judah in Jesus' genealogy, Judas the Galilean revolutionary, Judas of Damascus, Judas the apostle (son of James), Judas Iscariot (the betrayer), Judas Barsabbas, and Judas (brother of Jesus).
BDAG.pt: Judas/Judá. Usado para o filho do patriarca Jacó, a tribo de Judá, o país de Judá, e para vários indivíduos: Judá na genealogia de Jesus, Judas o galileu revolucionário, Judas de Damasco, Judas o apóstolo (filho de Tiago), Judas Iscariotes (o traidor), Judas Barsabás, e Judas (irmão de Jesus).

DEFINITION: Julia, a Roman Christian, probably a slave or freed from the Imperial household.
ORIGIN: Feminine of the same as Ioulios; Julia, a Christian woman.

BDAG.en: Julia, a common name, recipient of a greeting.
BDAG.pt: Júlia, um nome comum, destinatária de uma saudação.

DEFINITION: Julius, a Roman centurion on special service.
ORIGIN: Of Latin origin; Julius, a centurion.

BDAG.en: Julius (a common name, borne by a centurion)
BDAG.pt: Júlio (um nome comum, portado por um centurião)

DEFINITION: Junia, Junias, a Roman Christian.
ORIGIN: Of Latin origin; Junias, a Christian.

BDAG.en: Junias (a Judean Christian, imprisoned with Paul or shared a similar experience)
BDAG.pt: Junias (um cristão judeu, aprisionado com Paulo ou que compartilhou uma experiência semelhante)

DEFINITION: Justus, (a) a surname of Joseph Barsabbas, one of the two nominated to fill Judas' place as apostle, (b) Titius Justus, a Corinthian Christian, (c) surname of Jesus, a Christian with Paul in Rome.
ORIGIN: Of Latin origin ("just"); Justus, the name of three Christian.

BDAG.en: Justus, surname of Joseph Barsabbas; of Titius, a Corinthian proselyte; and of a Jewish Christian named Jesus who supported Paul.
BDAG.pt: Justo, sobrenome de José, chamado Barrabás; de Tício, um prosélito coríntio; e de um cristão judeu chamado Jesus que apoiava Paulo.

DEFINITION: a horse-soldier, a mounted soldier, a cavalryman.
ORIGIN: From hippos; an equestrian, i.e. Member of a cavalry corps.

BDAG.en: horse rider, cavalryman.
BDAG.pt: cavaleiro, soldado de cavalaria.

DEFINITION: horsemen, cavalry.
ORIGIN: Neuter of a derivative of hippos; the cavalry force.

DEFINITION: a horse.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain affinity; a horse.

BDAG.en: horse, steed.
BDAG.pt: cavalo, corcel.

DEFINITION: a rainbow or halo.
ORIGIN: Perhaps from ereo (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities); a rainbow ("iris").

BDAG.en: rainbow; an arc or circle of light, halo, radiance.
BDAG.pt: arco-íris; um arco ou círculo de luz, auréola, radiância.

DEFINITION: (Hebrew), Isaac, the patriarch.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yitschaq); Isaac (i.e. Jitschak), the son of Abraham.

BDAG.en: Isaac, son of Abraham and father of Jacob; referenced in relation to the covenant promises and his sacrifice.
BDAG.pt: Isaque, filho de Abraão e pai de Jacó; referenciado em relação às promessas da aliança e ao seu sacrifício.

DEFINITION: equal to or like the angels.
ORIGIN: From isos and aggelos; like an angel, i.e. Angelic.

BDAG.en: like an angel of the glorified ones.
BDAG.pt: semelhante a um anjo dos glorificados.

DEFINITION: Issachar, a proper name.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yissaskar); Isachar (i.e. Jissaskar), a son of Jacob (figuratively, his descendant).

DEFINITION: know.
ORIGIN: Assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of epikaluma; to know.

DEFINITION: agree, give thyself wholly to.
ORIGIN: Second person imperative present of eimi; be thou.
USAGE: + agree, be, X give thyself wholly to.

BDAG.en: See εἰμί (the imperative form of 'to be').
BDAG.pt: Ver εἰμί (a forma imperativa de 'ser').

DEFINITION: Iscariot, surname of Judas and his father.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (probably 'iysh and qirya'); inhabitant of Kerioth; Iscariotes (i.e. Keriothite), an epithet of Judas the traitor.

DEFINITION: equal, equivalent, identical.
ORIGIN: Probably from eido (through the idea of seeming); similar (in amount and kind).

BDAG.en: equivalent in number, size, quality; equal; consistent (of testimony); to treat equally.
BDAG.pt: equivalente em número, tamanho, qualidade; igual; consistente (de testemunho); tratar igualmente.

DEFINITION: equality; equality of treatment, fairness.
ORIGIN: Likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication, equity.

BDAG.en: state of matters being held in proper balance, equality; state of being fair, fairness
BDAG.pt: estado de equilíbrio adequado das coisas, igualdade; estado de ser justo, justiça

DEFINITION: equally privileged, equal in honor.
ORIGIN: From isos and time; of equal value or honor.

BDAG.en: equal in honor/value, also simply equal, like, of the same kind/value
BDAG.pt: igual em honra/valor, também simplesmente igual, semelhante, do mesmo tipo/valor

DEFINITION: like-minded, of the same mind or spirit.
ORIGIN: From isos and psuche; of similar spirit.

BDAG.en: of like soul/mind
BDAG.pt: de alma/mente semelhante

DEFINITION: (Hebrew), Israel, surname of Jacob, then the Jewish people, the people of God.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Yisra'el); Israel (i.e. Jisrael), the adopted name of Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: the patriarch Jacob, Israel; the descendants of Israel; the people/nation of Israel, Israel
BDAG.pt: o patriarca Jacó, Israel; os descendentes de Israel; o povo/nação de Israel, Israel

DEFINITION: an Israelite, one of the chosen people of Israel, a Jew.
ORIGIN: From Israel; an "Israelite", i.e. Descendant of Israel (literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: Israelite
BDAG.pt: israelita

DEFINITION: trans: (a) to make to stand, place, set up, establish, appoint; mid: to place myself, stand, (b) to set in balance, weigh; intrans: (c) to stand, stand by, stand still; met: to stand ready, stand firm, be steadfast.
ORIGIN: A prolonged form of a primary stao stah'-o (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses); to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively).
USAGE: abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up). Compare tithemi.

DEFINITION: to get acquainted with, visit.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of eido; to be knowing (learned), i.e. (by implication) to visit for information (interview).

BDAG.en: visit (for the purpose of coming to know someone or something).
BDAG.pt: visitar (com o propósito de conhecer alguém ou algo).

DEFINITION: strong (originally and generally of physical strength); mighty, powerful, vehement, sure.
ORIGIN: From ischus; forcible (literally or figuratively).
USAGE: boisterous, mighty(-ier), powerful, strong(-er, man), valiant.

BDAG.en: strong, mighty, powerful; pertaining to being strong physically, mentally, or spiritually, strong; pertaining to being high on a scale of extent as respects strength or impression that is made, violent, loud, mighty, etc.
BDAG.pt: forte, poderoso, pujante; relativo a ser forte física, mental ou espiritualmente, forte; relativo a ser alto em uma escala de extensão no que diz respeito à força ou impressão que causa, violento, alto, poderoso, etc.

DEFINITION: strength (absolutely), power, might, force, ability.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of is (force; compare eschon, a form of echo); forcefulness (literally or figuratively).

BDAG.en: capability to function effectively, strength, power, might.
BDAG.pt: capacidade de funcionar efetivamente, força, poder, pujança.

DEFINITION: to have strength, be strong, be in full health and vigor, be able; meton: to prevail.
ORIGIN: From ischus; to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively).
USAGE: be able, avail, can do(-not), could, be good, might, prevail, be of strength, be whole, + much work.

BDAG.en: be in possession of one’s physical powers, be in good health; to have requisite personal resources to accomplish someth., have power, be competent, be able; to be in control, have power, be mighty; Win out, prevail; have meaning, be valid, be in force, esp. as legal t.t.
BDAG.pt: estar na posse das próprias forças físicas, estar com boa saúde; ter os recursos pessoais necessários para realizar algo, ter poder, ser competente, ser capaz; estar no controle, ter poder, ser poderoso; vencer, prevalecer; ter significado, ser válido, estar em vigor, especialmente como termo legal.

DEFINITION: perhaps, equally; it may be that.
ORIGIN: Adverb from isos; likely, i.e. Perhaps.

BDAG.en: perhaps, probably
BDAG.pt: talvez, provavelmente

DEFINITION: Italy, a region of western Europe.
ORIGIN: Probably of foreign origin; Italia, a region of Europe.

BDAG.en: Italy
BDAG.pt: Itália

DEFINITION: Italian.
ORIGIN: From Italia; Italic, i.e. Belonging to Italia.

BDAG.en: Italian
BDAG.pt: italiano

DEFINITION: Ituraean, an adjective applied to a district also called Trachonitis, about 60 miles east of the Sea of Galilee, and partly inhabited by the nomad tribe called Ituraeans.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (Ytuwr); Ituraea (i.e. Jetur), a region of Palestine.

BDAG.en: Ituraea, a region along the Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon ranges belonging to the Tetrarchy of Philip

DEFINITION: and, even, also, namely.
ORIGIN: Apparently, a primary particle, having a copulative and sometimes also a cumulative force; and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words.
USAGE: and, also, both, but, even, for, if, or, so, that, then, therefore, when, yet.

BDAG.en: and, also, even; to introduce a result that comes from what precedes: and then, and so; introduces a short clause that confirms the existence of something that ought to be; emphasizing a fact as surprising or unexpected or noteworthy: and yet, and in spite of that, nevertheless; introduces an abrupt question; to introduce a parenthesis; often explicative: that is, namely; pleonastic (in some constructions); introducing something new, with loose connection; both ... and, not only ... but also; introduces contrasts: although ... yet; marker to indicate an additive relation that is not coordinate: also, likewise, functioning as an adverb; intensive: even; in formulas expressing a wish: if only, would that; in connection with a comparative; in sentences denoting a contrast; pleonastic with expressions that introduce cause or result; after an interrogative: at all, still; used with a relative, it often gives greater independence to the following relative clause; pleonastic with prepositions; who is also called; with other particles (e.g., καί γε: indeed, at least; καίτοι: yet, on the other hand; καίτοι γε: although).
BDAG.pt: e, também, até; para introduzir um resultado que advém do que precede: e então, e assim; introduz uma cláusula curta que confirma a existência de algo que deveria ser; enfatizando um fato como surpreendente, inesperado ou notável: mas, apesar disso, não obstante; introduz uma pergunta abrupta; para introduzir um parêntese; frequentemente explicativo: isto é, a saber; pleonástico (em algumas construções); introduzindo algo novo, com conexão solta; tanto ... quanto, não só ... mas também; introduz contrastes: embora ... ainda assim; marcador para indicar uma relação aditiva que não é coordenada: também, da mesma forma, funcionando como advérbio; intensivo: até mesmo; em fórmulas que expressam um desejo: se ao menos, tomara que; em conexão com um comparativo; em frases que denotam contraste; pleonástico com expressões que introduzem causa ou resultado; após um interrogativo: de todo, ainda; usado com um relativo, frequentemente confere maior independência à oração relativa seguinte; pleonástico com preposições; aquele que é também chamado de; com outras partículas (ex: καί γε: de fato, pelo menos; καίτοι: contudo, por outro lado; καίτοι γε: embora).

DEFINITION: (lit: an evil-worker), a criminal.

DEFINITION: to treat evilly, hurt, torment.

DEFINITION: badly, evilly, wrongly.

DEFINITION: affliction, ill-treatment, oppression, misery.

DEFINITION: stubble, straw, the stalk.

DEFINITION: a reed; a reed-pen, reed-staff, measuring rod.

BDAG.en: reed, swaying in the wind, easily broken; stalk, staff; measuring rod; reed pen
BDAG.pt: caniço, que balança ao vento, facilmente quebrado; colmo, vara; vara de medir; pena de junco

DEFINITION: (a) to call, summon, invite, (b) to call, name.
ORIGIN: Akin to the base of keleuo; to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise).

BDAG.en: to identify by name or attribute, call, call by name, name; to request the presence of someone at a social gathering, invite; to use authority to have a person or group appear, summon; choose for receipt of a special benefit or experience, call
BDAG.pt: identificar pelo nome ou atributo, chamar, nomear; solicitar a presença de alguém em uma reunião social, convidar; usar a autoridade para fazer uma pessoa ou grupo comparecer, convocar; escolher para receber um benefício ou experiência especial, chamar

DEFINITION: a cultivated olive (tree).
ORIGIN: From the base of kallion and elaia; a cultivated olive tree, i.e. A domesticated or improved one.

BDAG.en: The cultivated olive tree (opposed to the wild olive tree).
BDAG.pt: A oliveira cultivada (em oposição à oliveira brava).

DEFINITION: very well.
ORIGIN: Neuter of the (irregular) comparative of kalos; (adverbially) better than many.

BDAG.en: See καλῶς (adv. form).
BDAG.pt: Ver καλῶς (forma adverbial).

DEFINITION: a teacher of that which is noble (honorable) and good.
ORIGIN: From kalos and didaskalos; a teacher of the right.

BDAG.en: Teaching what is good (used of elderly women).
BDAG.pt: Que ensina o que é bom (usado para mulheres idosas).

DEFINITION: Fair Havens, a harbor in Crete.
ORIGIN: Plural of kalos and limen; Good Harbors, i.e. Fairhaven, a bay of Crete.

DEFINITION: to do well, act honorably, do what is right.

BDAG.en: To do what is right, what is good.
BDAG.pt: Fazer o que é certo, o que é bom.

DEFINITION: beautiful, as an outward sign of the inward good, noble, honorable character; good, worthy, honorable, noble, and seen to be so.

BDAG.pt: belo, bonito, de boa aparência; bom, útil; moralmente bom, nobre, louvável; irrepreensível, sem defeito, excelente; agradável, desejável, vantajoso; moralmente bom, agradável a Deus; bom, medida completa; certo, correto

DEFINITION: a covering, especially a covering of head and face, a veil.
ORIGIN: From kalupto; a cover, i.e. Veil.

BDAG.en: Head-covering, veil (literally, or figuratively as a covering that prevents understanding).
BDAG.pt: Cobertura de cabeça, véu (literalmente, ou figurativamente como uma cobertura que impede o entendimento).

DEFINITION: to veil, hide, conceal, envelop.

BDAG.en: cover, hide, conceal; to cause to be covered in some physical way, cover someone (up) lit.; to cause someth. not to be known, hide, conceal, keep secret
BDAG.pt: cobrir, esconder, ocultar; fazer com que algo seja fisicamente coberto, cobrir alguém literalmente; fazer com que algo não seja conhecido, esconder, ocultar, manter em segredo

DEFINITION: well, nobly, honorably, rightly.
ORIGIN: Adverb from kalos; well (usually morally).

BDAG.en: well, beautifully; fitly, appropriately, in the right way, splendidly; commendably, in a manner free from objection; of advantage, in a manner that is beneficial/acceptable, well; rightly, correctly; fortunately; in irony
BDAG.pt: bem, lindamente; adequadamente, apropriadamente, do jeito certo, esplendidamente; louvavelmente, de maneira irrepreensível; de vantagem, de maneira benéfica/aceitável, bem; corretamente, certo; afortunadamente; ironicamente

DEFINITION: a camel or dromedary.

DEFINITION: a furnace, oven, kiln.

BDAG.pt: forno, fornalha; forno de fogo, forno de queima; inferno (figurado)

DEFINITION: to close, shut the eyes.

BDAG.en: close (the eyes), fig. of an attitude of hostility toward the gospel
BDAG.pt: fechar (os olhos), fig. de uma atitude de hostilidade para com o evangelho

DEFINITION: to work, be weary, be sick.

BDAG.en: be weary, fatigued; be ill; die (rarely)
BDAG.pt: estar cansado, fatigado; estar doente; morrer (raramente)

BDAG.pt: dobrar ou inclinar alguma parte do corpo, dobrar, curvar (frequentemente como gesto de respeito ou devoção); assumir uma postura de curvatura, dobrar-se (a si mesmo)

BDAG.pt: Caná, nome de uma cidade na Galileia

DEFINITION: Cananaean, Aramaic for Zealot, surname of one of the twelve apostles.

BDAG.pt: homem de Caná, Cananeu (usado por alguns manuscritos para substituir Καναναῖος)

DEFINITION: Candace, a proper name; the Candace, a dynastic name for queens of the Ethiopians in Abyssinia.

BDAG.pt: Candace (título da rainha da Etiópia)

DEFINITION: Capernaum, a town of Galilee.
ORIGIN: Of Hebrew origin (probably kaphar and Nachuwm); Capernaum (i.e. Caphanachum), a place in Palestine.

BDAG.en: see Καφαρναούμ (Capernaum)
BDAG.pt: ver Καφαρναούμ (Cafarnaum)

DEFINITION: to hawk, trade in, deal in for purposes of gain.
ORIGIN: From kapelos (a huckster); to retail, i.e. (by implication) to adulterate (figuratively).

BDAG.pt: comerciar, vender a retalho, agenciar; fig. corromper ou adulterar (a palavra de Deus)

DEFINITION: smoke.
ORIGIN: Of uncertain affinity; smoke.

BDAG.en: smoke
BDAG.pt: fumaça

DEFINITION: Cappadocia, a large Roman province in the central eastern part of Asia Minor.
ORIGIN: Of foreign origin; Cappadocia, a region of Asia Minor.

BDAG.pt: Capadócia, uma província no interior da Ásia Menor.

DEFINITION: Carpus, a Christian of Troas.
ORIGIN: Perhaps for karpos; Carpus, probably a Christian.

BDAG.en: Carpus, a Christian in Troas
BDAG.pt: Carpo, um cristão em Troas

DEFINITION: to bear fruit.

DEFINITION: fruitful.

BDAG.en: fruitbearing, fruitful (referring to times/seasons).
BDAG.pt: que dá fruto, frutífero (referindo-se a tempos/estações).

DEFINITION: to persevere, endure, be steadfast, patient.
ORIGIN: From a derivative of kratos (transposed); to be strong, i.e. (figuratively) steadfast (patient).

BDAG.en: to continue without wavering in a state or condition, be strong, be steadfast, hold out, endure (especially by keeping an invisible object in view, i.e., in faith).
BDAG.pt: continuar sem vacilar em um estado ou condição, ser forte, ser firme, aguentar, perseverar (especialmente mantendo um objeto invisível em vista, ou seja, na fé).

DEFINITION: a dry stalk, chip of wood, twig, splinter, chaff.

BDAG.pt: um pequeno pedaço de palha, palha de cereal ou madeira, para denotar algo totalmente insignificante, lasca, farpa, estilha

DEFINITION: gen: against, down from, throughout, by; acc: over against, among, daily, day-by-day, each day, according to, by way of.
ORIGIN: A primary particle; (prepositionally) down (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case (genitive, dative or accusative) with which it is joined).
USAGE: about, according as (to), after, against, (when they were) X alone, among, and, X apart, (even, like) as (concerning, pertaining to touching), X aside, at, before, beyond, by, to the charge of, (charita-)bly, concerning, + covered, (dai-)ly, down, every, (+ far more) exceeding, X more excellent, for, from... To, godly, in(-asmuch, divers, every, -to, respect of),... By, after the manner of, + by any means, beyond (out of) measure, X mightily, more, X natural, of (up-)on (X part), out (of every), over against, (+ your) X own, + particularly, so, through(-oughout, -oughout every), thus, (un-)to(-gether, -ward), X uttermost, where(-by), with. In composition it retains many of these applications, and frequently denotes opposition, distribution, or intensity.

BDAG.en: Preposition. With genitive: (1) location/extension: down from, off; deep into; throughout (an area). (2) hostiliy/opposition: toward, against, by (swearing by). (3) separation: by oneself, alone. (4) distributive (spatial): x by x, from x to x. With accusative: (1) spatial extension: along, over, through, in, upon; toward, up to; isolation/separateness. (2) temporal extension: at, on, during; toward, about. (3) distributive (temporal/division): x period by x period, daily, every year; in detail, by name, two by two. (4) intention/goal: for the purpose of, to. (5) norm/similarity: according to, in accordance with, just as.
BDAG.pt: Preposição. Com o genitivo: (1) localização/extensão: para baixo de, fora de; profundamente em; por toda parte (de uma área). (2) hostilidade/oposição: em direção a, contra, por (jurando por). (3) separação: por si mesmo, sozinho. (4) distributivo (espacial): x por x, de x a x. Com o acusativo: (1) extensão espacial: ao longo de, sobre, através de, em, em cima de; em direção a, até; isolamento/separação. (2) extensão temporal: em, durante; em direção a, por volta de. (3) distributivo (temporal/divisão): x período por x período, diariamente, todos os anos; em detalhe, por nome, dois a dois. (4) intenção/objetivo: com o propósito de, para. (5) norma/similaridade: de acordo com, em conformidade com, assim como.

DEFINITION: to go down, come down, either from the sky or from higher land, descend.

DEFINITION: (a) mid: to lay, of a foundation, (b) met: to cast down, prostrate.

BDAG.en: to strike with sufficient force so as to knock down, throw down, strike down; to lay something down with implication of permanence, found, lay (a foundation).

DEFINITION: to bring down, cast down, cause to go down.

DEFINITION: a reporter, announcer, proclaimer, herald.

DEFINITION: to laugh at, ridicule.

DEFINITION: to condemn, blame.

DEFINITION: to break down (in pieces), crush, break into.

BDAG.pt: quebrar um junco; quebrar membros do corpo

DEFINITION: to subdue (in warfare); to struggle against, conquer, overcome.
ORIGIN: From kata and agonizomai; to struggle against, i.e. (by implication) to overcome.

BDAG.pt: conquistar, derrotar, vencer (uma pessoa, um reino)

DEFINITION: to bind up, bandage.
ORIGIN: From kata and deo; to tie down, i.e. Bandage (a wound).

DEFINITION: quite clear, evident.
